stong/ /bka' brgyud thergas nga nor bu'i phreng ba/phyogs sgrig pa/ mkhan po bsod nams rgya mtsho/
'anene/ byanengutsa t+ya5 byapa'ajaco 0'gu7melo snyepya20kha' spyo/khame'alo'ab35 cir+ṣakha snye'asnu'7byapom5ma①ner+ṣane 5'a 'ikro'abapu5khonguba'/2009

dkar chag 1dkar chag 1 sngon brjod / 1//grub chen til+li pa'i rnam thar/ 3paṇa chen nā ro pa'i rnam thar/ 7mnga' bdag mi tri pa'i rnam thar/ 12mnga' bdag mar pa lo tswa'i rnam thar/ 15rngeg chos sku rdo rje'i rnam thar/ /7mes ston tshon po'i rnam thar/ 19mtshur ston dbang nge'i rnam thar/ 21rje btsun mi la ras pa'i rnam thar/ 23rje ras chung pa'i rnam thar/ 32mnyam med sgam po pa'i rnam thar/ 35dbon sgom tshul khrims snying po'i rnam thar/ ci 42'ba' ram dar ma dbang phyug gi rnam thar/ 46zhang tshal pa bcesan 'khru/sa grags pa'i rnam thar/ 49karma pa dus gsum mkhyen pa'i rnam thar/ 51

/1 dkar chagazur mang bka' brgyud/ 53gnas mdo bka' brgyud/ 53'gro mgon phag mo gru pa'i rnam thar/ 55skyob pa 'jig rten mgon po'i rnam thar/ 61chos rje stag lung thang pa'i rnam thar/ 67rgyal tsha rin chen mgon dang dbon kun ldan ras chung gi rnam thar/ 73khro phu lo tsā ba'i rnam thar/ 75chos rje smar pa shes rab ye shes kyi rnam thar/ 79yel ye shes brtsegs pa'i rnam thar/ 83zwa ra ba skal ldan ye shes seng ge'i rnam thar/ 87de'i slob ma g.ya 'a bzang chos rje ni/ 88mnyam med gyer sgom chen po'i rnam thar/ 90grub chen gling chen ras pa'i rnam thar/ 90'gro mgon gtsang pa rgya ras kyi rnam thar/ 96bar 'brug bu chen dang bu chung gi brgyud 'dzin ni/ 104'bras 31 ba sangs rgyas 'bum ni/ 105

dkar cha ga 11161 ras grags pa dbang phyug gi rnam thar/ 106rgyal ba rgod tshang pa'i rnam thar/ 111rgyal ba yang dgon pa'i rnam thar/ 117spyan snga ba rin chen ldan gyi rnam thar/ 119zur phug pa rin chen dpal gyi rnam thar/ 121chos rje 'ba' ra ba rgyal mtshan dpal bzang gi rnam thar/ 122grub thob u rgyan pa'i rnam thar/ 124dbon ras dar ma seng ge'i rnam thar/ 136de'i slob ma g.ya 'a bzang chos rje ni/ 88mnyam med gyer sgom chen po'i rnam thar/ 90grub chen gling chen ras pa'i rnam thar/ 90'gro mgon gtsang pa rgya ras kyi rnam thar/ 96bar 'brug bu chen dang bu chung gi brgyud 'dzin ni/ 104'bras 31 ba sangs rgyas 'bum ni/ 105

gleng brjod/༄༅/ /mnyam med shākya'i rgyal po'i bstan pa'i nying khu skal ldan 'dul bya rnams tshe gcig lus gcig la sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang thob pa'i thabs lam tshul bzhin ston pa/ dwags po'i bka' brgyud kyi ring lugs dri ma med pa 'di nyid/ ji ltar dar tshul/ mdor bsdus nor bu'i phreng ba 'di ni/ lo shas sngon wa ṇa mtho slob slob phrug 'dus sde 'ga' nas bskul ma yang yang byas pa dang / gzhan yang spyi sger lhan tshogs mang pos/ dwags po bka' brgyud kyi bla ma rnams kyi lo rgyus smu/dor bsdus zhig dgos mkho che tshul dus dang dus su dgongs 'char bton pas/ da lan 'dir bka' brgyud pa'i bla ma yongs grags brgyud 'dzin mi 'dra ba byung ba rnams kyi lo rgyus shin tu bsdus pa 'di bzhin 'jam mgon kong sprul yon tan rgya mtsho'i shes bya kun khyab mdzod las/ bka' brgyud bla ma'i brgyud 'dzin mi 'dra ba byung tshul dbye gzhi/ gzhi bzhag thog /sngon gyi mkhas pa tshad ldan rnams kyi gsungs/ deb ther sngon po/ mkhas pa'i dga' ston/ chos 'byung bstan pa'i pad+ma rgyas pa'i nyin byed/ tshal pa'i deb dmar/ lho rong chos 'byung / stag lung chos 'byung / bka' brgyud gser phreng mi 'dra ba 'ga' shas sogs dpe cha rnams la gzhi bcol zhing / lo tshig rnams skad yig sna tshogs thog yod pa'i bka'

gleng brjod/ 5brgyud pa'i lo rgyus khag dang / bod rgya tshig mdzod chen mo rnams la gzhi bcol nas yi shu'i 'das lo'i dus rabs dbyin ji'i ang ki thog shad 'gug nang bcug nas bris yod/lo rgyus shin tu bsdus pa 'dis brgyud pa rin po che'i bla ma ji ltar byung tshul rags tsam dkar chag gi tshul tsam las/ zhib cha ga la tshang bas sku1 rgyus kyi skor la rang re bka' brgyud pa'i bla ma rnams kyi chos 'byung rgyal rabs gser phreng / rnam thar/ gsan yig /gdan rabs lo rgyus sogs grangs las 'das pa bzhugs pa rnams la gzigs 'tshal/chos 'byung mdor bsdus 'di yi deng dus spyi tshogs yar thon brel zing gi skye bo rnams la sman byang gi tshul du ngo sprod mdo tsam yong ba'i ched dang /rang la yid ches re ltos gnang mkhan don gnyer can rnams kyi bskul ma ma zlog tsam gyi ched phyogs bsgrigs zhus pa yin/ dpe deb 'di yi phyogs bsgrigs skabs gus kyi gcen po sku zhabs chos dpal mchog nas zhu dag gnang rgyu dang rang dgon wā ṇa khra 'gu badz+ra bibyā'i dge slong tshe ring dang / kam pur ṭar phyag las gnang mkhan 'jam dbyangs bkris sogs blo dkar dam gtsang chos grogs rnams nas phya ra gru 'degs kyi phyag rogs gnang bar thugs rje che zhu/

ra༅༅/ /bka' brgyud 31sa cesar bu'i phreng ba/ston pa dam chos dge 'dun la//mi phyid gus pas phyag 'tshal nas//bka' brgyud nor bu'i phreng ba yi//rnam thar mdor bsdus phyogs gcig bya//༄༅/ /mnyam med 'gro mgon dwags po bka' brgyud zhes mtshan gyis snyan pa sa gsum na mngon par 'phags pa 'di nyid kyi skor cung zad zhig gleng na/ bka' brgyud pa zhes pa ni/ rgyal ba rdo rje 'chang nas rim par brgyud de grub pa'i dbang phyug til+le pas 'aka' babs kyi bla ma bzhi'i gdams pa'i brgyud 'dzin yin pas na bka' brgyud pa zhes bya la/ kun mkhyen pad+ma dkar po sogs 'ga' zhig gi dkar brgyud pa zhes kyang bya la/ de yang rgyal ba rdo rje 'chang nas da lta'i rtsa ba'i bla ma'i bar brgyud pa'i gdams pa rnams byin rlabs kyi chu bo ma nyams zhing / dam tshigs kyi sel sogaru/ nag nog gi dri mas cung zad kyang ma gos pa mtshon don ras dkar nam bza' can gyi brgyud 'dzin yin pas na dkar brgyud pa zhes kyang bya'o//

2 bka' brgyud chos 'byung nor bu'i phreng ba/ji skad du/ mjam mgon blo gros mtha' yas kyis shes bya kun khyab mdzod las/ bka' bzhi brgyud 'dus nā ro me tri yi/ /rgyal tshab mnga' bdag lo tswa'i bshad sgrub bka'/ /ka chen bzhir babs khyad par mi la rje'i/ /snyan brgyud 'dzin pa nyi zla lta bu gnyis/ /grub rgyal ti pu'i thugs sras ras chung pa'i/ /gdams zab gangs can grub mtha' yongs kyi gsos/ /rgyal bas lung bstan dge slong 'tsho byed sras/ 'ba' rom phag gru rka tshang tshal pa ste/ /che bzhi rtsa ba'i brgyud 'dzin bcas te lnga/ /phag gru'i slob ma 'bri stag khro gling gnyis/ /smar yel g.ya' shug zung bzhi ya brgyad las/ /gling sras ca'abrug pa stod smad bar dang gsum/ /drug pa seng ge dus mkhyen rtsa ba'i brgyud/ /zur mang gnas mdo gsum ste phyi ma las/ /kar rnying brgyud 'dzin mdo smad phal cher khyab/ /dwags po bka' brgyud grub thob sa yi rdul/ /rgyal bstan ji srid mi 'chad kun las 'phags/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar/ brgyud pa rin po che 'di nyid kyi shing rta'i srol 'byed ni/ grub pa'i dbang phyug til+li pa yin la/

grub chen tiwi pa'i rnam thar/ 3grub chen til+li pa'i rnam thar/grub pa'i dbang phyug til+li pa ni rgya gar shar phyogs za hor yul gyi bye brag dza go ra zhes bya ba'i yul du yab bram ze gsal ba dang yum bram ze mo gsal ldan gnyis kyis sras su sku 'khrungs/(988—1069) sku chung ngu'i dus su bram ze'i lugs kyi bstan bcos thams cad la mkhas par mdzad/ rab tu byung nas mtshan shes rab bzang po gsol/ so ma pu ri'i gtsug lag khang du lo bcu gnyis sgrub pa mdzad/ gdams pa'i brgyud tshul yang / thun mong ma yin pa'i ngor nye brgyud rgyal ba rdo rje 'chang nas dngos su gdams pa rnams gsan nas brgyud pa dang / thun mong ngor ring brgyud bka' babs kyi bla ma bzhi sogs las gdams pa rnams brgyud pa'o//de yang thun min rgyal ba rdo rje 'chang las gsang sngags rdo rje theg pa'i rgyud sde gdams pa rnams rdzogs par gsan pa ni/ grub chen tisnyi pa bhaṅga lar byon nas dur khrod du tsa'i spyil po bcas te bzhugs pa'i tshe/ skye bo phal cher gyi de nyid du ting nge 'dzin la bzhugs pa mthong la/ don du rnam smin gyi lus 'di khas 'og min zhing du/ yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas rdo rje 'chang chen po rigs drug gi khyab bdag de dang bgros nas gsang sngags kyi rgyud sde rnams rdzogs par gsan/ 'dzam bu gling du log ste/ bskyed rim

1 bka' brgyud chos 'byung nor bu'i phreng ba/thams cad yan lag bzhi drug /rdzogs rim pha rgyud rim lnga/ ma rgyud phyag rgya bzhi/ lhag par tshig gsum du bstan pa thams cad bsdus pa/ shin tu rmad du byung ba'i rgyud ces grags pa bsnams te dril bsgrags/ ji skad du/rje nyid kyis/ nga lus dgyes pa'i rdo rje ste/ /ngag ni ma hā mā yā yin/ /sems ni bde mchog lubor lo nyid/ /dbang po gsang ba 'dus pa yin/ /yan lag dgra rgyud nag po ste/ /nyid lag rdo rje 'jigs byed che/ /ba spu dus gsum sangs rgyas kyi/ /sku gsung thugs dang dbyer med do/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar ro/ /u rgyan dharma gañja nas ye shes kyi mkha' 'gro ma rnams las snyan brgyud nor bu skor gsum gsan/ /bcom ldan 'das mas/ bdag gi yab gyur bcom ldan 'das/ /bde mchog 'khor lo bde ba'i mchog /til+li sangs rgyas 'gro ba'i mgon/ /yid bzhin nor bu rnam gsum 'bul/ /zhes gsungs nas/ snyan brgyud kyi gdams ngag rnams rdzogs par gsan/ u rgyan dharma gtā'i rgyud thams cad kyi bdag por bskos/ lus med mkha' 'gro'i chos skor dgu sogs gdams pa rnams rdzogs par gsan/ ji skad du/ bhaṅga lar/ til+li nga la mi yi bla ma med/ /nga yi bla ma thams cad mkhyen pa yin/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar ro//gdul bya thun mong dang mthun pa ring brgyud bka' babs kyi bla ma gtso bo bzhi sogs las grub chen til+li pas gsang sngags rdo rje theg pa'i chos

grub chen tisnyi pa'i rnam thar/ sgru5tshul rnams rdzogs par gsan par ni/ rje rang byung rdo rjes/ yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas rdo rje 'chang chen pos gsang ba'i bdag po la sogs pa'i byang chub sems dpa' rnams la gsungs/ de rnams nas bka' babs bzhi brgyud pa'i bla ma rnams la brgyud de/ zhes sogs gsungs pa ltar bka' babs dang po ni/ rdo rje 'chang nas rgyal po in+d+ra bhū dhi/ klu las gyur pa'i rnal 'byor ma/ sa bdag bi su kalpa/ grub chen sa ra ha/ 'phags mchog klu sgrub zhabs las/ pha rgyud gsang ba 'dus pa dang / de'i rdzogs rim/rim lnga dmar khrid/ gdan bzhi/ chos drug gi sgyu lus/ 'pho ba dang grong 'jug rnams grub chen til+li pas gsan / bka' babs gnyis pa ni/ rdo rje 'chang / ye shes kyi mkha' 'gro ma/ku ku ri pa/ tsār+ya pa las/ ma rgyud ma hā mā yā dang / chos drug nang gi rmi lam gyi skor rnams grub chen til+li pas gsan/bka' babs gsum pa ni/ rdo rje 'chang / phyag na rdo rje/ ḍom bi he ru ka /bi na sa/ la ba pa las/ bde mchog sogs rgyud rnams dang / chos drug gi 'od gsal gtso bor gyur pa'i rdzogs rim gyi skor rnams grub chen til+li pas gsan/bka' babs bzhi pa ni/ rdo rje 'chang / phyag na rdo rje/ yan lag med pa'i rdo rje/ pad+ma badz+ra/ mkha' 'gro ma skal pa bzang mo las/ dgyes rdor rtsa

6 bka' brgyud chos 'byung nor bu'i phreng ba/bshad kyi rgyud rnams dang chos drug nang gi gtum mo sogs gdams pa mtha' dag grub chen til+li pa'i thugs rgyud la yongs su 'phos pa'o/ /de ltar yang til+li pa nyid kyi zhal nas/ tsār+ya klu sgrub lwa ba pa/ /ma ti skal ba bzang mo ste/ /bka' babs bzhi yi bla ma bsten/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar/ /thun mong ring brgyud rdo rje 'chang nas rim par bka' babs kyi bla ma rnams las grub pa'i dbang phyug til+li pa'i bar brgyud pa'o/ /slob ma'i gtso bor bram ze ri ri pa/ rje rigs ka so ri pa/ rgyal rigs nā ro pa sogs skal ldan rnams rjes su 'dzin nas grol te za hor gyi yul rnams lan gsum stongs par grags so//

paṇa chen nā ro pa'i rnam thar/ 7paṇa chen nā ro pa'i rnam thar/grub chen til+li pa'i slob ma'i gtso bo paṇa chen nā ro pa ni/ kha che'i yul du / yab rgyal po dge ba'i go cha dang / yum dpal gyi blo gros kyi sras su sku 'khrungs/(1016—1100) cher skyes nas bram ze'i las drug la sogs pa phyi rel pa'i rig pa'i gnas thams cad /cong du chud/ sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa la dad nas yab yum la gnang ba zhus te/ yul de nyid kyi dgra bcom pa lnga brgya'i bzhugs gnas bdud rtsi 'byung ba'i gtsug lag khang zhes bya bar/bye brag smra ba'i 'dul 'dzin/ dzi na mi tra las rab tu byung / sde snod gsum par gyur nas yul dbus nā len+d+rar byon/ gnas brtan klu'i sde/ a ka ra shārnyi pa/ rigs sngags 'chang rgyal ba'i sde sogs las theg pa chen po gnyis kyi gzhung lugs rgya mtsho lta bu gsan bsam mdzad/ mu stegs byed kyi rgol ba dag rtsod pa'i grwar 'dul ba/ rang gzhan gyi sde pa thams cad kyi rtsod med lung dang rig pa smra ba thams cad kyi gcug gi nor bur bkur/ nā len+d+rara'i ma/ban po mjad/ dus 'khor/ dgyes rdor/ 'dus pa rgyud phyi ma sogs kyi 'grel pa mdzad nas yun ring bstan pa bskyangs/sems la dbang thob pa'i gdams pa zhig dgos par 'dug dgongs

8 bka' brgyud chos 'gyur nor bu'i phreng ba/nas/ rgyud kyi glegs bam zhig kha phye/ de la gzigs rtog byed pa'i skabs grib ma nag yol gyi byung ba su yin bltas pas/ bud med mi sdug pa'i mtshan bco brgyad yod pa 'jigs su rung ba zhig rgyab na snang / de na re/ khyod kyi klog pa de'i tshig shes sam don shes zer/ tshig shes byas pas dga'/ don shes byas pas ngu'o/ de la ngas tshig shes byas pa la dga'/ don shes byas pa la ci'i phyir mi dga' bar byas pas/ de na re/ khyod paṇ+ḍi ta mkhas pas tshig shes zer ba drang por smras pas dga' ba yin/ don shes zer ba rdzun du smra pas ngus so zer/ /'o na 'di'i don shes pa su yod byas pas nga'i ming pos shes/ gzhan gyi mi shes zer/ ming po su byas pas/ til+li pa'o zer nas mi snang bar gyur to/ /de mkha' 'gro ma'i lung bstan yang dag pa yin min yi dam gyi bsnyen pa byas pas shes snyam nas/ bde mchog yi ge bdun pa'i gsang sngags bzlas/ zhag bdun sngags 'bum phrag gcig song ba'i tho rangs/ sa g.yo/ 'od 'bar/ nam mkha' nas khyod rgya gar shar phyogs su song zhig de na rnal 'byor gyi dbang phyug til+li pa bya ba yod kyi des khyed rjes su 'dzin par 'gyur to zhes lung bstan no// de nas mtshams grol te nā len+d+rar dge 'dun la gnang ba zhus nas/dge 'dun gyi sdes nan chen pos bzhugs par gsol ba btab kyang ma gnang /grogs rin chen rdo rje lhan du 'dong ngam byas pas/ nga rig pa'i gnas lnga

paṇa chen nā ro pa'i rnam thar/ 9la mkhas pa ku sa li la 'dud du mi 'gro/ khyod rang yang 'dir bzhugs zer/khong la nā len+d+ra'i mkhan po gtad de go ḍa ba'i yul du chas so/ /shar phyogs gnas nges med rnams su bla ma dris pas ming tsam yang rtsad ma chod/ rgyal po'i bla mchod mdzad/ /zhing skyong gi mkha' 'gro ma gnyis kyis khyod rang gi skye ba bdun gyi bla ma shar phyogs bhaṅga la'i rgyud na bzhugs pa lung bstan pa ltar dka' ba brgya phrag gi shar phyogs kun tu bla ma rtsal yang ma rnyed/o tan+t+ra gtsug gi nor bu'i gtsug lag khang gi dge 'dun de dag gis gang nas byon sogs drir byung ba la ji lta ba bsnyad/ de dag gi bkur bsti chen po byas so/ /bla ma grub chen til+li pa rtsad bcad bzhin yod pa la/ rnal 'byor pa ras kyi ang rag tsam min pa'i gos med pa/ lus nyi lhags kyis gdungs pas sngo skya/ ral pa spyi bor bcing pa zhig gis nya gson po khrig ma gang khyer nas/ dge 'dun gyi tshang mal du/ 'bras btsos pa'i me dmar 'dur re ba la bsregs pas/ thab ka ba rnams rub ste rdeg pa btsams pa na/ de na re/ khyed rnams mi dga' 'am zer/ /dge 'dun gyi gnas su nya gson sreg byed pa la ga na dga' byas pa/ lū hi dza byas pas nya thams cad nam mkhar 'phur song bas/ thams cad kyi grub thob tu shes nas brdegs pa la bzod gsol byas so/ /der 'di su yin dris pas sprang po til+li pa zer ba 'di yin zer/ dpal nā ro pas 'di kha grub pa'i dbang phyug til+li pa'o

/() bka' brgyud chos 'byung nor bu'i preng ba/snyam nas/ de'i phyir bzhin 'brangs pas/ gtsug lag khang chen po'i rgya phibs kyi rtse la bzhud/ 'di nas mar mchong nus pa su yod gsungs/ bltas pas gzhan su yang med par nga la gsung ba yin snyam tsham tshom med par mchongs pas rkang lag dang rtsib ma chag rgyu long dang don snying la zug /lus byin 'dam bu bcom par ltar song / dran pa med par song ba na/ rnal 'byor pa der 'ong nas lus la phyag gis byugs pas skad cig de la sngar bzhin gsos pas thams cad yid ches so/ de bzhin lo bcu gnyis la dka' chen bcu gnyis rim pa bzhin/ lo gnyis par mkhal khung thur ma rgyab/ lo gsum par dpung pas me dpung dkrugs/ lo bzhi par mi gtsang 'dam rdzab zos/ lo lnga par 'bras chen ston mo brkus/ lo drug par rgyal po'i bag ma 'phrog /lo bdun par blon po'i chung ma brkus/ lo brgyad par rang gi chung ma blang / lo dgu par rdo rje tho bas brdung / lo bcu par chung ma bla mar phul/ lo bcu gcig par pad+ma'i zam pa byas//lo bcu gnyis par thang chen du maṇ+ḍal phul ched chu btsal bas ma rnyed par lus kyi khrag rtsa gtar te khrag gis chag chag btab/ me tog med nas rna ba dang nying lag btubs te tshom bu bkod pas khrag mang po shor bas brgyal la khad na/ tilbi pas mchil lham phud de/ kye ho 'di ni rang rig ye shes te/ /ngag gi lam 'das yid kyi spyod yul min/ /til+li ngas ni ci yang

paṇa chen nā ro pa'i rnam thar/ 11bstan du med/ /rang gis rang nyid mtshon te shes par phyos/ /zhes lham dpral bar 'phangs pa phog pas 'gyel/ brgyal sangs pa na/ de kho na nyi da mngon sum du gzigs/ de ltar rgya mtsho dang 'dra ba'i mtshon bya don bstan nas/ chu bo dang 'dra ba'i mtshon byed shin tu rmad du byung ba'i rgyud la sogs pa dang / khyad par snyan rgyud de bum pa gang byo bstan to/ bi kra ma shi la'i gtsug lag khang du gcer bu pa rnams rtsod du 'ong ba pham par mdzad/ de'i skabs kyi rgyal po nir ya pā las gsol ba btab pa bzhin/ bi kra ma shrī la'i byang sgo bsrung ba'i paṇ+ḍi ta mdzad/ de'i skabs kyi 'phags yul du yongs su grags pa'i paṇa grub phal cher rnams nā ro pa'i slob ma gyur/ kha che'i rgyal pos gur gum gyi zhing gyi ldongs dang nye ba na ri bo zhig la dpal me tog mdangs 'phrog pa'i gtsug lag khang ngam puṣa pa ha ri bgyis nas spyan drangs te/ de phul bla mar bzung ngo / gzhan yang rdzu 'phrul ya ma zung bsam gyi mi khyab pa bstan nas mthar phyogs las rnam rgyal gyi spyod pa brtsams te/ nyi ma bdun gyis phyag rgya chen po mchog gi dngos grub thob pas/ sku ma spangs par mkha' spyod chen por gshegs/slob ma mchog thob pa'i paṇa chen brgya rtsa brgyad/ de'i nang nas mchog gyur brgyad/ shān+ti bha dra/ shān+ti pa/ mi tri pa/ ḍom bi pa/ gnas brtan byang chub bzang po/ sdi ti/ kha che ā ka ra sidhi/ a ti sha sogs grangs las 'das pa byung ngo //

12 bka' brgyud chos 'byung nor bu'i phreng ba/ mnga' bdag mi tri pa'i rnam thar /mnga' bdag mi tri pa ni yul dbus kyi grong khyer gra byi lar bram ze'i rigs su 'khrungs/ (1002—1077) mtshan dharma/ skyes stobs kyi shes rab che bas mu stegs kyi sgra khang du bzhugs nas pā ṇi bya ka ra ṇa dang / mu stegs byed kyi grub mtha' ma lus pa bslabs/ de nas ka bi ka'i yul du shān+ti pa mjal/ bsnyen par rdzogs mtshan mi tri gup+ta zhes btags te sde snod gsum sbyang / mi tri pas rab tu mi gnas pa bzung / shān+ti pas rnam rdzun pa'i phyogs bzung ste chos kyi 'bel gtam byas pas/ mi tri pa rig pa bzang nas slob dpon khros nas sgor bton/ yi dam sgrol ma dang spyan ras gzigs kyi zhal gzigs dang / rnal 'byor gyi dbang phyug sha wa ri pas rjes su gzung ba lung bstan ltar/ nam mkha' lta bu'i rgyud rnyog pa med pa/ rgya mtsho lta bu'i rgyud gsang ba 'dus pa/ ye shes lta bu'i rgyud dgyes pa rdo rje/ byin rlabs lta bu'i rgyud 'khor lo sdom pa/ sde mig lta bu'i rgyud mtshan brjod/ don mthar thug ston pa grub snying gi chos 'khor thams cad gsan/ mtshan gnyis med rdo rje dang / a wa dhu ti pa zhes gsol/ mu stegs kyi ston pa trang se na zhes bya bas rtsod par 'dod pa bzhin/ rgyal po sa mun dzas rtsod pa'i ra bar /khri bshams/shān+ti pa sogs nang pa dang phyi rol pa'i dpang po bkod/ lta ba rab tu mi

mnga' bdag mi tri pa'i rnam thar/ 13 gnas pa/ sgom pa yid la mi byed pa la sogs pa'i dam bca' mdzadabyude rig pa bkod/ lung gis rgyab skyor bstan pas/ khos ma thub nas mi tri pa chen po rgyal bas rgyal ba zhes grags/ kho 'khor bcas rab tu byung / shārnyi pas de la skyon bris te rdo rje gdan gyi dus mchod kyi tshe sgo'i ya lcibs la sbyar/ mi tri pas rtsod pa bya phyir/ cis kyang 'byon par zhus pas shārnyi pa bang chen lan bcu gsum gyi bar bstud de btang kyang ma byon/de phan rdo rje gdan gyi dus mchod kyi bdag po khong gi mdzad pa la/ de nas rgyal pos mi tri pa la mtshan mnga' bdag ces te/ thams cad du mnga' bdag rgyal ba mi tri pa zhes grags rbe1//bi kra ma shi lar bzhugs tshe yi dam rnal 'byor ma'i nang gi dam tshig gi rdzas la chang nyos pas/ jo bo rje dpal mar me mdzad dge skos yin pas gzigs te dge 'dun gyis gnas nas phyung bas/ khrims nyams pa sgo nas 'gro mi rung zhes rtsig pa la thogs med byon/ chu bo gaṅgā la gding ba bting nas gshegs/ phar 'gram du jo bo sogs thams cad kyi bzhugs par gsol bas bzod pa bzhes kyang bzhugs par ma gnang / rgya gar shar phyogs ri bo me ltar 'bar ba'i dgon pa btab nas/ a ma ṇa si'i chos 'khor nyer bzhi sogs mdzad/ skabs zhig badz+ra pa ṇis khyod song la nye 'khor gyi slob ma rnams sdus shig gsung nas bsdus/ de nas mchod pa rgya chen po

1mo / bka' brgyud chos 'byung nor bu'i phreng ba/ dang tshogs kyi 'khor lo bshams nas slob ma rnams la byin rlabs kyi rten re bstsal/ zhal chems gdams ngag tu gsungs/ 'khor rnams kyis lo mang bzhugs par gsol ba btab pas sdod dbang yod de/ dngos grub sgrub pa'i dus las nyams par 'gyur bas mi rung gsung / dgung lo bdun cu rtsa lnga par mkha' spyod chen por gshegs so/ /slob ma bsam gyi mi khyab pa bzhugs pa'i gtso bo che bar bzhi ni/ mu stegs na ri ka ra btul pa lhan cig skyes pa'i rdo rje/ rgyal po rā ma pā la/ de wa kā ra/ badz+ra pa ṇi dang / abhi yuk+ta sogs 'bring bdun/ ri phu pa sogs chung bcu/ mar pa sogs thugs kyi sras bzhi grags rber+sha//

mnga' bdag mar pa lo tswa'i rnam thar/ /ri5mnga' bdag mar pa lo tsā'i rnam thar/nā ro mi tri yi rgyal tshab/ gangs can ljongs 'dir rdo rje theg pa'i bshad pa dang sgrub pa tharme sa cad sgo nas bstan pa'i bdag por 'jog 'os pa mnga' bdag mar pa lo tsā ni/ lho brag chu khyer/ gdung mar pa/ yab dbang phyug 'od zer dang yum skal ldan skyid gnyis kyi sras su sku 'brungs/ (1012—1100) gzhon nu nas bris klog mkhas par mkhyen/ 'brog mi lo tsā ba (992—1073) las sgra skad lo tsā tshad du bslabs/ rgya gar du phebs pa'i spobs pa zhabrungs/ paṇa chen nā ro mi tri/ zhi ba bzang po/ ye shes snying po/ lcam ni gu ma/ dpal siṅga li pa rnams dang gnal lam du sa ra ha sogs bla ma rnams kyi zhabs la gtugs nas gdams ngag rnams rjerdzogs par thugs nyams su bzhed/ rgya gar du byon theng dang po la lo bcu dgu/ bar la lo drug mtha' mar 61 gcig bzhugs/ dgung lo bcu gnyis nas lnga bcu rtsa gnyis bar la sbyangs pa mdzad/ ji skad du/ nga mar ston chos kyi blo gros 'di/ tshe gsum gnyis rgya gar yul du bskyal/ lo bzhi bcu'i bar du thos bsam byas/zhes dang / rgya gar yul du lan gsum phyin/ lus srog la ma bltas dam chos btsal/ zhes gsungs pa ltar/ dgung lo nga gsum pa nas skal ldan gyi slob ma rnams la rang rang gi skal pa dang rjes su mthun pa'i bshad pa dang

1() bka' brgyud chos 'byung nor bu'i phreng ba/skrub pa'i bka' babs kyi gdams pa stsa95/ stso1ba tshogs bsam gyis mi khyab pa bzhugs pa las slob ma'i gtso bo ka chen bzhir grags pa ni/ te/ rngog chos sku rdo rje la / dgyes rdor/ gur/ ma hā mā yā/ gdan bzhi rtsa bshad 'grel pa man ngag dang bcas pa gnang / rjes kyi brgyud pa bdun tshun brgyud pa 'dzin thub pa byin gyis brlabs/ 'di nas brgyud pa'i chos skor la rngog gi chos skor zhes grags/ // me ston tshon po la bde dgyes gsang gsum ma hā mā yā sangs rgyas thod pa man ngag dang bcas pa gnang / lde/ dol gyi mtshur ston dbang nge la gsang 'dus lugs gsum/ rtsa rgyud sgron gsal/rgyud phyi rtsa 'grel/ bskyed rdzogs kyi man ngag dgyes rdor sogs gnang / 'di gsum la bshad brgyud mu tig star la rgyus pa lta bu'i bka' babs thes grags/ 4) rje btsun mi la la bde dgyes gsang 'dus/ gdan bzhi/sangs rgyas thod pa/ma hā mā yā rnams kyi rgyud dbang sgrub thabs rim pa gnyis dang bcas pa snying po don gyi skor rnams rdzogs par gnang / sgrub brgyud kyi bka' babs pas brgyud 'dzin shin tu dar zhing rgyas pa byung ngo / /de nas rje mar pas grong 'dug kyang 'ga' re mdzad de bstan/ sku'i bkod pa'ang du mar snang / ting nge 'dzin gyi dkyil 'khor sprul nas mngon sum du ston/ sa thams cad rdzogs kyang sa bcu'i tshul 'dzin/ brgyad cu rtsa brgyad pa la yum bdag med ma 'od kyi gong bur byas te thugs khar bsdus/ 'gro don gzhan

rngog chos sku rdo rje'i rnam thar/ 17rgya che bar dgongs pa dang sku gdung gi gdul bya gzigs nas sku'i spyi bo nas 'od dang bcas te bla ma yid dam mkha' 'gro'i tshogs kyi gdugs rgyal mtshan rol mo'i sgras mchod pa'i sprin dang lhan du sku'i bkod pa bsdus so//྅drog 31sa sku thedu rje'i rnam thar/dpal sgra bsgyur gyi rgyal po mar pa lo tsā ba chos kyi blo gros kyi bshad pa dang / sgrub pa'i bka' babs ka chen bzhi'i dang po dgyes rdor dang bsre 'pho sogs rgyud kyi bshad pa'i bka' babs lho'i ka chen rjog chos sku rdo rje ni/ zhabrungs yul gzhung ri bor/ rngog lo tsā ba khu dbon dang yab tshan drung po/ yab ban chen kha po dang / yum 'od ldan ma'i sras su sku 'khrungs/(1036—1097) sngags rnying ma slob tu gtsang sgyer phu'i gtsug khang du skyer chung pa'i sku mdun nas gsan bsam thil phyin mdzad/ sgyer phu'i chag lo yang mjal/ dge bshes sgyer chung pas rje mar pa'i bsngags pa brjod pas mtshan thos nas dad pa tshad med skyes/ rngog dgung lo bcu drug tsam la/ rje mar pa dgung 81 zhe drug tsam yin pas zhabs la gtugs/ bdag med lha mo bco lnga'i dbang zhus nas nyams su blangs pas ring por ma thogs par dkyil 'khor dngos su zhal gzigs/ bla ma la bdag skal bar ldan nam

18 bka' brgyud chos 'byung nor bu'i phreng ba/chos 'di byin rlabs che ba yin zhus pas/ gnyis ka yin gsungs/ gdams ngag rnams rdzogs par gsan/ ri bo khyung lding gi lha khang btab/ ka ca sprong dag lan gsum mdzad/ dgyes rdor rtsa 'grel mā yā/ gdan bzhi yongs rdzogs so so'i man ngag /khyad par bsre 'pho gnad kyi mtshams spyor sogs rngog dkyil bdun sogs rngog pa'i chos skor rnams thos pa dang bsgrub pa stabs su mdzad pas ye shes kyi sku bsnyes te dgung lo drug cu rtsa gcig pa la mkha' spyod du gshegs/slob ma'i gtso bo/ ram rtsa can/ spa lnga ba can/ rngog mun pa can/ sum pa phod ka can dang khyad par rigs chos gnyis ka'i sras rngog zhe sdang rdo rje nas rim bzhin rngog bdun brgyud de bshad pa mdzad pa las brgyud 'dzin rgya shin tu che ba 'phel zhing / brgyud pa snga phyi rnams kyis brtsams pa'i rgyud 'grel gyis lung pa thams cad gang ngo //mar pa dgung lo zhe drug tsam yin pas zhabs la gtugs/ bdag med lha mo bco lnga'i dbang zhus nas nyams su blangs pas ring por ma thogs par dkyil 'khor dngos su zhal gzigs/ bla ma la bdag skal bar ldan nam

mes ston tshon po'i rnam thar/khyesprodzi5 shertocani 31phyo/ 21'i rna64 grosazapa/ka chen bzhi'i bde dgyes gsang gsum ma hā mā yā sangs rgyas thod pa man ngag dang bcas pa'i bka' babs nub kyi ka chen mes ston tshon po ni nyang stod stag tshal du zhabrungs/mtshan bsod nam rgyal mtshan/rje mar pa'i zhabs la gtugs nas gdams ngag rnams rdzogs par gsan/rje mar pa la 'bul mo che spong dag lan gsum mdzad pas zhabs tog gis mnyes par mdzad/gnas gzhi ba tho btab/skal pa dang ldan pa rnams rjes su 'dzin cing rgyud kyi bshad pa mdzad/ brtag gnyis la ṭī ka mdzad/ bde dgyes gsang gsum ma hā mā yā sangs rgyas thod pa sogs rgyud sde rnams kyi grwa btsugs/sku khams bzang ba'i tshe zhag bdun tsam mnal gcig la 'gro/rong ngur smrig tu gshin po rjes 'dzin phebs pa la mes ston gyis chang gsol gyin gzims rang bzhugs/ dge bshes gzhan rnams cho ga mdzad pas yon bdag blo ma bde/ gzhan rnams kyis khrel bgad byas/ yon bdag gis yang yang thugs dam mdzad par zhus pas/kho re tsho ngas khyed kyi gshen po rjes 'dzin tsam min pa da lta grong gong ma ya gir rgan mo zhig sna khrag 'dzags te shi song /de tshun yar 'dren byas yod gsungs pa ltar song bas ji lta ba

2() bka' brgyud chos 'byung nor bu'i phreng ba/bzhin 'dug pa thams cad yid ches/phyis nga zhag nyer gcig nyal/ de nas ma longs na ro 'di bsregs gsungs pa la/ zhag bcu dgu song nas dbon po zhig gis log mi srid snyam/bsgul bas shangs nas khrag mang po brdol te sku mdangs yal lo/ /slob ma'i gtso bo dbon mes kun po sogs mes na rim dang / zhang ston nas rim bzhin ye shes snying po/ de las zhang ston kun dga' grags sogs mes lugs kyi bshad pa rnams byung ngo //gsang gsum ma hā mā yā sangs rgyas thod pa rmags rgyud sde rnams rkya grwa btsugs/sku khams bzang ba'i tshe zhag bdun tsam mnal gcig la 'gro/ rong ngur smrig tu gshin po rjes 'dzin phebs pa la mes ston gyis chang gsol gyin gzims rang bzhugs/ dge bshes gzhan rnams cho ga mdzad pas yon bdag blo ma bde/ gzhan rnams kyis khrel bgad byas/ yon bdag gis yang yang thugs dam mdzad par zhus pas/ kho re tsho ngas khyed kyi gshen po rjes 'dzin tsam min pa da lta grong gong ma ya gir rgan mo zhig sna khrag 'dzags te shi song / de tshun yar 'dren byas yod gsungs pa ltar song bas ji lta ba

mtshur ston dbang nge'i rnam thar/ 21mtshur ston dbang nge'i rnam thar/ka chen bzhi'i gsang 'dus lugs gsum/ rtsa rgyud sgron gsal/ rgyud phyi rtsa 'grel/ bskyed rdzogs kyi man ngag dgyes rdor sogs kyi ka babs/shar gyi ka chen mtshur ston dbang nge ni/ yul dol gyi mda'/ gdung mtshur gyi rigs sngags 'chang shin tu mthu che ba zhig gi sras su zhakhrungs/ dge bshes lce ba sogs las slob gnyer la dka' spyad brtson pa chen po mdzad/ sku bsod rgyas/ 'bum bzhengs pa'i yig mkhan la da lta gsang ba 'dus pa la su mkhas dris pas/ lho brag mar pa lo tsā mkhas zer ba dad de dro bo lung du byon/ bla ma'i sku dgra mar pa mgo nag la mthu rgyab te btul/ bla ma mnyes nas chos phra mo 'dra gnang / phyis mtshur gyis dol mdar rang gi gnas su bla ma mar pa spyan drangs shing / gsang ba 'dus pa'i rgyud lugs bzhi ka'i man ngag dang bcas pa rdzogs par gsan nas 'bul mo che mdzad/ mtshur ston gyi slob ma gtso bo khams pa ro mnyarme rdo rje/ mkhon gad pa gīrti/ mches ston bsod rgyal rnams yin/ 'khon gad pa kirtis brgyud pa gzhan la mkhas par lobs/ man ngag la ma mgu bar mtshur ston las gsan nas nyams len mdzad pas ting nge 'dzin du ma rgyud la skyes/ des thur la ba tshul khrims/des thang dpe ba 'phags pa skyabs/ des gser ldings pa gzhon nu 'od/

22 bka' brgyud chos 'gro nor bu'i phreng ba/des chos sku 'od zer/ des 'phags 'od yon tan rgya mtsho/ des bu ston rin po ches gsan/ bu ston la dpal ldan bla ma dam pa dang shar pa ye shes rgya mtsho gnyis kyis gsan nas sa skya pa rnams la gsang 'dus de gnyis las brgyud/ yang bu ston rin po che'i dngos slob dag las red mda' ba/de las rje tsong kha pas gsan te nyams bzhes kyi snying po 'di la mdzad/ yang kun mkhyen bu ston nas thugs sras lo tsā ba/ de las sku zhang chos rje rnams las rang re dwags po bka' brgyud pa rnams la brgyud nas/ de ltar gsang ba 'dus pa'i bka' babs da lta'i bar du mi nyams pa bzhugs so / /man ngag dang bcas pa rdzogs par gsan nas 'bul mo che mdzad/ mtshur ston gyi slob ma gtso bo khams pa ro mnyarme rdo rje/ mkhon gad pa gīrti/ mches ston bsod rgyal rnams yin/ 'khon gad pa gīrtis brgyud pa gzhan la mkhas par lobs/ man ngag la ma mgu bar mtshur ston las gsan nas nyams len mdzad pas ting nge 'dzin du ma rgyud la skyes/ des thur la ba tshul khrims/des thang dpe ba 'phags pa skyabs/ des gser ldings pa gzhon nu 'od/

rje btsun mi la ras pa'i rnam thar/ 2 3rje btsun mi la ras ba 'i rnam thar/ka chen bzhi'i sgrub brgyud kyi bka' babs/ byang gi ka chen rje btsun mi la ras pa ni yul mnga' ris gung thang du yab mi la shes rab rgyal mchan dang yum myang tsha dkar rgyan gyi sras su zhabrungs/ (1040—1123) mtshan thos pa dga' gsol/ sku chung ngu'i dus nas yab gshegs/ kha chems 'jog lugs nor nas rdzas rnams a khu dang a ne+e la bcol/ rje bcun dgung lo bcu dru ga lon pa na ston mo gshams/ mas da bus khyim so zin pa 'dug pas nor rnams phyir sprod dgos pa'i rgyu mtshan glengs pas a khu a ne nor phyir sprod rgyu med tshul dang / thal lcag gis brdungs nas/ mang na dmag drongs nyung na mthu rgyab zer nas thon/ de nas thos pa dga' lo tsā ba glan chung las skra bcad/ 'bri klog dang phyag rdor dang phag mo sogs gsan/ slob dpon gyi zla la skyid ston zhig la phyin/ mi rnams glu len pa la sems 'phros nas chang gis kyang bzi/ glu len cing 'ongs pa mas thos nas/ pha mi la shes rab rgyal mtshan la bu khyod 'dra skye ba/ nged ma smad kyi sdug bsngal dang 'khos khyer 'di la glu dran pa 'dug zer nas brgyal/ bsangs ba'i thabs byas nas mas ci gsung byed byas pas/ dbus gtsang du song la mthu slob la dgra thams cad phung la thong zer/

21 bka' brgyud chos lūng nor bu'i phreng ba/dgung lo bco brgyad la/ yar klung na bla ma g.yung ston khro rgyal dang / gtsang rong gi lha rje gnubs chung ye shes gzungs gnyis las mthu dang ser ba'i rtags thon pa sbyang nas dgra rnams thams cad brlag par mdzad/ bla ma rnams gnyis kyi phyag phyir dang gsan pa lo 'ga' shas mdzad/ mi mang po bsad pa'i sdig pa ji ltar sbyang dgos snyam yod pa dang / bla ma'i yon bdag zhig shi bas bla mas thugs skyo nas/ thos pa dga' nged rang gnyis sdig pa chen po bsags yod pas/ yang na khyod kyis chos gsha' ma zhig gyis la nga drongs/ ngas brgyags skyel/ yang na ngas chos gsha' ma zhig byas khyed drang / khyod kyi nga'i tshogs pa 'di kun skyongs la nga la brgyags skyol gsungs pas skabs rnyed na bdag gis chos bya bar zhus/ 'o na de kha gyis/ khyod na so yang gzhon/ snying rus kyang che bar 'dug gsungs/ gtsang du byon nas/gnubs mjal nas/ myang stod rgyang khar du skyer ston dbang nge las rdzogs chen zhus gsungs/ gdams ngag rnams zhus nas/ des khor re bya bar ngab mi byang chub rgyal po sgyu 'phrul yang dag bdud rtsi rnams la mkhas pa zhig yod pa der brdzangs/ des yar 'brog dor mar pa 'byung nge bya ba ma mo mkhan zhig gi rtsar gtang nas tshul de bzhin gyis bla ma dgu bsten/ khong gis gtsang rong gi 'bre ston lha dga' la gtad de rdzogs chen gsan/ yongs dril lo bco lnga tsam/ gdams ngag rnams bla ma dang mnyam zer ba'i bar sbyangs rnga/ che/ bskyed rim la nus pa thon par byung /

rje btsun mi la ras pa'i rnam thar/ 25bla ma 'bre ston lha dga' nas da lta lto brag chu khyer na rgya gar gyi grub thob nā ro pa dang mi tri pa'i dngos glob rgya gar du yun ring phebs te dka' ba mang du spyad pa mar pa lo tsā zhes/ gsang sngags kyi byin rlabs kyi lam rten 'brel lus la bsgrigs pas rtogs pa sems la 'char ba zhig yod 'dug /nged rang bla slob der 'gro dgos min nam gsungs/ rje mar pa'i mtshan thos pa tsam gyis lus ba spu zing / mchi ma lhug par shor/ da lta rang de'i drung du bsleb na bsam pa 'khrungs/ sman thang brgyud de byon/ de ring 'byor rgyu'i mdang dgong der rje mar pa la mnal lam du/ bla ma nā ro pas gnang pa'i be+e ḍār+ya'i rdo rje dri mas gos pa zhig byung ba khrus mdzad de/ rgyal mtshan gyi rtse la phyar bas 'od kyis phyogs bcu khyab pa—zhig rmis/ yum bdag med ma la yang / bla ma nā ro pas bla ma la gnang ba yin snyam pa'i shel gyi mchod rten dri mas gos pa khrus byas/ ri rtser bskyal bas kun gyis phyag mchod byed/ de'i dkor gnyer bud med gnyis kyis byed pa zhig smis/ der bsu ba la bla ma mar pa zhing gi khru slog la skad mdzad de byon/ der bla ma mjal/ de kha la snang ba 'gyur yang ngo ma shes/ bla ma mar pa rtsad gcad pas bla mas mjal sna bcol bas chang 'di 'thung la zhing gi phru 'di rlog gsungs/ dum zhig na byis pa zhig 'bod du byung bas/ khong gi go bcad 'dug pas ngas kyang go chod pa byed dgos bsam nas/ phru lhag med rmos/chang yang lhag med du btung bas rten 'brel 'grigs/ de nas bla ma mjal

26 bka' brgyud chos 'cho nor bu'i phreng ba/ba dang mar pa lo tsā nga rang yin gsungs/ der bdag la stod nas 'ongs ba'i mi sdig po che zhig lags pas thugs rjes gzung nas tshe gcig lus gcig la sangs rgyas pa'i gdams ngag gcig gnang bar zhu byas pas bla mas gdams ngag yod/ sangs rgya mi rgya khyod rang gi snying rus la rags las gasdo/ngas/de'i skabs lho brag la kha bas bla ma'i grwa pa brdungs 'tshog mang du byas pas mthu gyis gsungs/ khong tsho nang 'dzings kyi mi 'ga' shi/ bla mas mthu chen du btags/ de nas sdig spyong ched bla ma mar pas/ ri zur gcig tu sras kyi ched mkhar gyi rmang zlum po zhig brtsigs/ thog so gnyis tsam longs pa dang / de bzhig zla gam/ de'ang bzhig/ gru gsum/ de'ang bzhig nas da lta'i sras mkhar 'di'i rmang bting / thog so bdun tshar ba dang / khyams rtsig tu bcug de thams cad la mi la rang min pa rdo ra mgo tsam zhig dang sa khyem gang skyel rogs med/ de'i bar la chos gnang la re nas/ mes rngog mtshur sogs dbang gsan pa la byon pa'i dkyil 'tshangs pas/ gral nas bton phyag 'bebs 'chi ba la gtugs pa gnang / rgyun du rkyen phra mo la bsnyad btags nas bka' skyon phyag 'bebs mdzad de yi chad theng bdun song ba'i bar la yum la zhus/ sgal mig gsum rdol ba bstan nas bla ma la chos zhus pa ma gnang / rgyab kyi rma ma drag pas sa rdo pang du bzung zhing

rje btsun mi la ras pa'i rnam thar/ 27bskyal te bla mas gdams ngag mi gnang ba 'dra bsam thugs mug /yum gyis snying rjes ma bzod nas byin rlabs rten 'ga' dang phyag tham yig rdzus bcas mthu chen bla ma rngog pa'i mdun brdzangs/rngog gi grwa rigs dol yas pho yas mo bas bsdungs pa de la ser ba phob gsungs pas phab/ gnas tshang rgan mo'i zhing rnams ri mo bris pa sla ngas bkab pas skyon ma byung / gzhan pa'i zhing thams cad bcom/ de nas lam du bya byi'u'i ro rnams bsdus nas bla ma'i spyan sngar dkyil 'khor gyi stegs bu yod pa'i khar spungs nas bshums pas bla mas ci'ang mi lto/ jo bo nā ro pa'i bu brgyud la sdig po che btsan thabs su sangs rgyas pa'i gdams ngag yod/ cung zad dgongs pa la bzhugs te mthar se gol gtogs pas thams cad nam mkha' la phur/ des bla ma yab sras la yid ches/ rngog gis gdams ngag gnang yang bla ma'i bka' ma grol bas myong ba ma skyes/ sras kyi che 'don skabs rngog bu slob rnams bla ma'i spyan sngar byon/ bla mas phyag sdig mdzub gtad de/ mthu chen la dbang bskur man ngag ster ba'i rgyu mtshan ci yin gsungs/ rngog bred nas bla ma rang gi phyag tham dang byin rten rnams byung lags zhus/ mthu chen la sus bskur gsungs/ bred nas yum gyis gnang lags zhus/ yum la phyag 'bebs du phebs pas yum gyis sgo rgyab ste bzhugs/ a pho mthu chen gyis phung po nga 'dra ba/ nga rang ma zad yum dang bla

28 bka' brgyud chos 'byung nor bu'i phreng ba/ma la'ang 'di lta bu'i 'o brgyal byung / nga skye ba phyi ma chos dang mjal ba zhig thugs rjes 'dzin dgos zhes lceb par brtsams pa na/ bla ma rngog pas gsang sngags lugs la phung po sangs rgyas kyi bdag nyid la brnyas na rtsa lhung phog mdo lugs la'ang sdig pa che shos su gsungs pas de ltar ma byed gasdo/ngas/de nas bla ma mar pa thugs sos nas bdag med ma shog gsungs/yum gyis sngar gyi lo rgyus rnams zhus nas mthu chen rjes su 'dzin pa zhus pas/ 'o na shog gyis gsungs/ mthu chen yid ma ches/ bla ma mar pa'i zhal nas/ da res 'bod pa'i mgron gyi gtso bo a pho mthu chen yin/ bdag med ma rang song la bos shog gsungs/ de'i tshe bla ma thugs zhi nas/ rang re kun la skyon med/ ngas ni mthu chen gyi sdig pa sbyong phyir byas/ bdag med ma ni spyir bud med sems chung / khyad par snying rje rab 'dug pas yig brdzus bskur/ rjog gis yi ge bskur nas de ltar byed pa bden mod/ 'on kyang byin rlabs rten rnams tshar cig 'dir skyol phyis khyod rang la ster gsungs/gral de nyid du skra bcad/ mtshan mnal lam bzhin rdo rje rgyal mtshan zhes btags/ dge bsnyen dang byang sems sdom pa gnang / gsang sngags kyi dbang bskur dpal 'khor lo sdom pa drug bcu rtsa gnyis kyis dbang gi/ sa chog/ sta gon dang / dngos gzhi dkyil 'khor bstan pa'i dus/ 'di mtshon

rje btsun mi la ras pa'i rnam thar/ 2()byed dpe'i dkyil 'khor yin/ mtshon bya don gyis dkyil 'khor 'di zhes bar snang la dkyil 'khor rten dang brten par bcas pa mngon sum du bzhugs pa mjal/ gsang mtshan 'dogs pa'i dus/ sa gsum gyi mkha' 'gro ma rnams kyi mgrin gcig tu bzhad pa'i rdo rje btags/ des nas dgyes rdor/ ma hā mā yā/ gdan bzhi/ sangs rgyas thod pa/ gsang 'dus/ de dag gi rgyud 'grel/ dbang sgrub thabs rim gnyis/ don mthar thug ston pa'i snying po skor/ bsre 'pho gnad kyi mtshams sbyor la dmar khrid du mdzad/ lho brag stag nya'i brag la sgom du bcug gdams ngag rnams gser zhun ma lta bu dril nas 'phri bsnan / lhag chad med pa/ ḍā ki dpang btsugs/ dbu snung bzhes nas rdzogs par gnang nas rjes su 'dzin to// de nas bla ma la gnang ba zhus te yul du phebs/ yum grong / sring mo 'khyar/ khang zhing 'jigs nas bdag med lus 'dug pa rnams la skyo shas gting nas skyes/ brag dkar rta sor/ 'tsho ba phye'i dri yod tsam lo gsum/ci'ang med pa thā rang gi tshod ma la brten pa lo drug ste dgu rtse gcig bsgoms/skabs zhig khyi ra ba rnams dang / sring mo pe ta/ mdzes se rnams kyis rtsam pa chang sha phul ba rnams bzhes pas sgom mi nus pa dang / sgom la bogs che bsam ma byung bas/ gegs 'di las che ba mi yong dgongs te/ bla mas gnang ba'i shog dril bltas pas rlung sems 'du rgyu lugs bzhin ngo 'phrod

ji)() bka' brgyud chos 'byung nor bu'i phreng ba/nas rtsa mdud grol/ sa rnams non/ de kho na nyid kyi ye shes shar/ brag dmar tshong lung / la phyir byon nas sgrub pa mdzad/ lha chen tshogs bdag dam la btags/ shen rdor mo sogs yon bdag rnams chos zhu 'ong / rje btsun gyis 'tsho chas nyung ngu zhig las ma bsnams pa byon/ dgongs mo kha mo che babs/ zla ba lnga tsam las lam ma phye ba/ bu slob rnams kyis rje btsun grong yod snya/ma nas gshegs rdzongs la dmigs nas mchod pa byas/ spur ram spur rus gang rnyed ltar 'ongs pas/ 'tsho chas cung zad las ma zad par 'dug pas ting nge 'dzin gyis 'tsho bar shes/ pha bong 'dam bzhin brdzis/grub pa thob nas smin phyugs grib ma'i ri dang phan tshun 'phur zhing sgoms/ling pa'i brag tu brag srin mo'i cho 'phrul snang ba dang / sman lung chu bar du tshe ring ma 'khor dang bcas pa phyag rgya gnyan po'i zil 'og tu mnan/ bka' 'bangs bgyid par brtsis la phab/ rjes su 'dzin nas nyid kyi las kyi phyag rgyar bzhes/ chu la mi byings pas zhu yas dar ma dbang phyug dang / khyi dang sha ba ma smad ltar dul bas khyi ra ba mgon po rdo rje btul/ mtsho ma pham phyag sor gyi rtse la len pa dang / ti se'i rtser gshegs pa la sogs pa'i rdzu 'phrul gyis nā ro bon chung btul/ thong la'i la thog tu dam pa sangs rgyas dang rdzu 'o/rgyul 'gran/ spangs rtogs mtshungs par zhal bzhes/rje ras chung pa chung ngu nas rjes su 'dzin lus med mkha' 'gro'i chos

rje btsun mi smu ras pa'i rnam thar/ 31skor lha ga ma dang zab chos gdams pa len ched rgya gar la brdzangs nas tshur 'khor dus ras chung pa nga rgyal skyes pa g.yag rwa che ru ma song / rje btsun chung du ma song bar bzhugs pa dang / dpe la chags pa rkyang ma brgya bu brgya/spyang ki ma brgya bu brgya'i 'bros 'ded / rje btsun rang gi sku'i rtsa 'khor bde dgyes gsang 'dus gdan thod mā yā drug tu bstan pa dang / bka' brgyud bla ma dang sngags kyi dkyil 'a/bor sogs dang / pha bong rta ltar bzhon/ chu snyeltar 'phyar/ mdam ltar rdzi ba sogs sku gsung thugs kyi bkod pa mtha' yas bstan nas nga rgyal lhag ma med par mjad/ bal po rdzong du dharma bo rnyi/shī la bha ro gnyis kyis rje bcun la gus pa'i phyag bcal/ dbus pa ston pa rje btsun rang gi rdzu 'phrul gyis thugs bsgyur nas bkug mjal dus chang bzhes 'phro gnang ba lhag med bzhes pas brgyud pa zin par dgongs/ bde mchog gyi dbang bskur skabs bum pa nam mkha' la 'phags te dbang bskur/ras chung pas phag mo'i bris thang la rab gnas zhus pas/ ye shes pa dam tshig pa la dngos su byon te de la thim/ bris sku dbu seng byas te me tog bzhes zhes grags so/ snyan pas sa thams cad khyab cing rje sgam po pa la bstan pa gtad de dgung lo gya bzhi la ngo mtshar ba'i sku'i bkod pa du ma dang bcas mngon dgar gshegs/slob ma'i gtso bo/ nyi ma lta bu sgam po pa dang zla ba lta bu ras chung pa sogs ras pa mched brgyad/ ston pa drug /ras ma bcu gnyis sogs bgrang gis mi lang ba byon no//

ji ṭ+wāṃ2 bka' brgyud chos 'byung nor bu'i phreng ba/ rje ras chung pa'i rnam thar/ras chung bka' brgyud ni/ de ltar dpal sgra sgyur gyi rgyal po mnga' bdag mar pa lo tsā ba'i sgrub pa'i bka' babs byang gi ka chen rnge bcun mi la'i slob ma'i gtso bo snyan brgyud 'dzin pa nyi zla lta bu gnyis las/ zla ba lta bu rje ras chung pa ni yul stod gung thang 'phrang rar yab gnyan dar ma grags kyi sras su 'khrungs/ (/083—1161) mtshan rdo rje grags su btags/ sku mdzes pa lha'i bu 'dra/ chung dus nas klog legs par bslab/'ordzo brgyad na yab gshegs/ yum a /skus bsdus/ de chos la mi dga' ba yum yang de dbang song nas shin tu sdang / klog bklags pas yon byung ba rnams snam nas za 'og phug tu rje btsun mi la'i rtsar byon/ de nas ma khus dbang med khrid nas khru slog tu bcug pas mdzes zin/ de nas rje btsun gyi drung du ma bsdad par khang stong zhig tu bsdad/ de'i tshe a tsa ra gsum byung nas de rnams kyis snying rje byas/ rgya gar du khrid nas bla ma ba la tsan+d+ra la gtugs/ gtum po khyung sham can gnang nas bzlas pa byas pas/ mdze lhag ma med par sos/ slar bal por 'ongs nas a ru la da sha la sogs las bde mchog sogs rgyud 'ga' re gsan/ de nas 'khor te rje btsun la btugs nas dbang gdams ngag mang po gsan/ bsgoms pas gtum mo'i

rje ras chung pa'i rnam thar/ ) 3dros rtags thon/ bla ma'i khrid gsar rnams kyi slob dpon mdzad/ de nas rje btsun gyis brdzangs nas rgya gar du phyi ma byon/ bla ma ti phu dang mjal nas nā ro mi tri nas brgyud pa'i gdams pa rnams gsan/ rje mi la la a ga ru'i phyag 'khar skyes bskur/ lus med mkha' 'gro'i chos skor dgu las rje mar pas lnga gdan drangs zhing lhag ma bzhi gdan drangs/ grub thob a mo gha brdzes ras chung pa zhag bdun las tshe med pa lung bstan ltar/ grub pa'i rgyal mo las tshe dpag med kyi sgrub thabs sogs gsan nas sku tshe sring / bsnyepa por phebs nas bha ri mas bsus te rgya dpe rnams kyi lhag chad bsal/bod du byon nas khengs pa cung zad 'brungs pa/ rje btsun gyis g.ya' ra dang / rkyang ma brgya bu brgya'i rdzu 'phrul bstan de bzlog rtsod yig sogs mu stegs kyi man ngag rnams bsregs/ gdams ngag rnams bla ma la skyes su phul/ skasnyel ldan gyi slob ma rnams la gdams ngag rdzogs par gnang/ sgo brag mkhar chur ro snyoms dang sangs rgyas thos chog gter du spas/ mi rabs gsum na chos 'di'i bdag po 'ong ba lung bstan/ phyis 'gro mgon gtsang pa rgya ras kyis gter nas bzhes/ sku lus ma spangs par mkha' spyod du gshegs/ slob ma'i gtso bo lo gcang ra dang byes 'gol ba bzhi la lho'i bu bzhi /khyung tshang pa/ 'bro sgom/ bur sgom/ rta shod ras pa la byang gi bu chen bzhi/

/)/ bka' brgyud chos 'byung nor bu'i phreng ba/gzhan yang la stod pa gnyan chos skyabs/ rje zla 'od gzhon nu/ sne'u zung pa/bya yul ba sogs dge ba'i bshes gnyen du mas zhabs la btugs so/ /gdan sa'i gtso bo mog par lha rtse brgyud 'dzin bu slob dang bcas pa la ras chung bka' brgyud zhes grags so//rgyal mo las tsha dpag rmad kye sgrub thabs sags gsan nas sku cha srang / bsnyepa por phebs nas bha ri mas bsus te rgya dpe rnams kyi lhag chad bsal/bod du byon nas khengs pa cung zad 'brungs pa/ rje btsun gyis g.ya' ra dang / rkyang ma brgya bu brgya'i rdzu 'phrul bstan de bzlog rtsod yig sogs mu stegs kyi man ngag rnams bsregs/ gdams ngag rnams bla ma la skyes su phul/ skasnyel ldan gyi slob ma rnams la gdams ngag rdzogs par gnang/ sgo brag mkhar chur ro snyoms dang sangs rgyas thos chog gter du spas/ mi rabs gsum na chos 'di'i bdag po 'ong ba lung bstan/ phyis 'gro mgon gtsang pa rgya ras kyis gter nas bzhes/ sku lus ma spangs par mkha' spyod du gshegs/ slob ma'i gtso bo lo gcang ra dang byes 'gol ba bzhi la glu'i bu bzhi/hwa khyung tshang pa/ 'bro sgom/ bur sgom/ rta shod ras pa la byang gi bu chen bzhi/

mnyam med sgam po pa'i rnam thar/ ( rtiri5mnyam med sgam lngardzo pa'i rnam thar/rje btsun mi la'i slob ma'i gtso bo snyan brgyud 'dzin pa nyi zla lta bu gnyis las nyi ma lta bu mnyam med sgam po pa'am dwags po lha rje ni/ bdag cag gi ston pa thub pa'i dbang po'i spyan sngar zla 'od gzhon nu'i rnam 'phrul/snying rje pad+ma dkar po dang ting nge 'dzin rgyal po'i mdo/ o rgyan pad+ma 'byung gnas/ mnga' bdag mar pa lo cwa sogs kyi lung bstan pa'i skyes bu de/bod yul mnyal se ba lung / gdung rus snyi ba/ yab snyi ba rgyal po dang yum ngal bza' gnyis kyi sras su sku 'khrungs/ (1079—1153)sku gzhon nu nas rig gnas spyi dang lhag par sman dang sngags la mkhas par gyur/ sman gyi 'gro don rgyun ring bskyangs/ dus nam zhig gi tshe sras dang sras mo jo mo rnams grong nas 'khor ba la nges 'byung shugs drag skyes/ gnas gzhi rnams bor nas dwags por byon/ mang yul ba blo ldan shes rab kyi mkhan po/ zhang zhung pa shes rab snying po las slob/ yid bde ba byang chub semos dpa' zhes pa bla ma mi la ras pa'i slob ma yang yin pa des/ gsang ston dang dus go ba dang / /ba skong bcas dad pa'i dge 'dun grangs tshang gi dbus su tshig rdzogs su bsnyen par rdzogs mchan bsod nams rin chen gsol/ de nas bzung dge slong gi bslab gzhi phra mo chun chad la srog las gces par srung / mkhan

ṭ+wāṃ() bka' brgyud chos 'byung nor bu'i phreng ba/slob las 'dul ba legs par bslabs/ mkhan po las bde mchog lū hi pa dang / phag mo rin chen rgyan drug sogs pha rgyud dang ma rgyud kyi dbang bskur byin rlabs/ rig gtad kyi ches bka' mang du zhus/ dge bshes spug rum pa dang / lcag ri ba/ gong dkar ba sogs las/ spyod 'jug dbu ma rig tshogs/ byams chos gsan/ bya 'dul 'dzin las 'dul ba'i sde snod/ ting nge 'dzin rgyal po'i mdo/ sa sde lnga/ theg bsdus sogs gzhung lugs mang du gsan zhing de dag gi don tshul bzhin bsam pa dang sgom pa'i sgo nas ma/bas pa chen por gyur/ dge bshes sdug rum pa dang rgya yon bdag gi mdun nas jo bo bka' gdams pa'i man ngag mtha' dag gsan/ g.yeng med gcig tu thos bsam sgom sgrub la brtson pas/ sku la srin bu mi 'byung ba/ zhag lnga drug cam 'tsho ba ma gsol kyang / bkres pa mi mnga' zhing / sku lus bde ba'i nyams dang ldan pa/ ting nge 'dzin rgyun gcig la zhag mang po gnas pa/chags sdang rags pa nub pa sogs byung /de nas skabs zhig yusnyel phyogs der mu ge chen po zhig byung / sprang po gsum phyogs gcig yod pa/ sprang po gcig na re/ 'o skol gsum bsod nams chung / de ring zan chen po dang lo ma'i tshod ma phor ba re za rgyu yod na zer/ gcig na re/ yid smon byed na de 'dras gang / mnga' bdag rtse sde 'dra byung na zer/ gcig na re/ mnga' bdag rtse sde la'ang 'chi ba 'ong / yid smon

mnyam med sgam po pa'i rnam thar/ shā37byed na /mi la ras pa la byed/ lus la gos mi dgos/ 'tsho ba mkha' 'gro mas 'dren/ gnas 'pho skyes byed pa na nam mkha' la 'phur nas 'gro/ skye shi'i 'jigs pa med pa de yi drung du tshe 'di blos gtang nas khong bzhin byung na dga' mod zer/ rje sgam po pas rje bcun gyi mchan thos pa'i mod la rang dbang med pa'i dad pa chen po skyes/ rje btsun bzhugs pa'i phyogs su phyag mang po 'tshal/ dus de ca na/ rje btsun mi la ras pa brag dmar spo mtho'i skyid phug nyi ma rdzong na slob ma rnams la chos 'khor bskor ba'i tshe ras pa rgan pa rnams kyis rje btsun la/ da rje btsun sku na yang bgres pas sku tshab gcig dgos par gda' bas/ rje btsun rang thugs gang ches pa gcig la gdams ngag rnams rdzogs par gnang nas mnga' gsol mdzad pa 'thad lags zhus pas/ rje btsun gyis nga la phrin las rgya cher spel nus pa'i slob ma yod de/ ga na 'dug do nub ngas lta bas sang snga dro shog gsungs/ nang par rje btsun gyis nga'i bstan pa 'dzin pa'i skyes bu gdams ngag rdzogs par len zhing / bstan pa phyogs bcur spel nus pa chos 'dul ba las rab tu byung ba'i dge slong lha rje'i ming can zhig myur du yong ba 'dug /mdang nga'i rmi lam na/ bu des shel bum stong pa gcig khyer nas nga'i dngul dkar bum pa bdud rtsis gang ba de/ kho'i bum par sib kyis byo ba zhig rmis pha rgas khar bu skyes/ sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa nyin mo ltar byed cing sems can

7 7(nyi bka' brgyud chos 'byung nor bu'i phreng ba/po da po rigs pas tshar bcad/ bcu bdun par rtse ston kun bzang las/ rdor ga dbyings sogs dkyil 'khor lnga brgya lhag gi phyag len man ngag bcas kyi gsan sgrub rdzogs par gnang / rnam sras kyi rjes 'dzin gyis longs spyod ma kyi mi phongs pa sogs phrin las rgyas/ zhang dge ba las lo cwa bslabs nas da mkhas par gyur/ bcu dgu par mkhan po rgyal tsha rin po che sogs dad pa'i da dge 'dun grangs tshang dbus su bsnye/na par rdzogs nas mtshan byams pa su dpal du gsol/ rgyal cha khu dbon las gdams ngag mi 'dra ba brgya dang nye sum cu rtsa drug dang / bka' babs bcu gsum sogs mtha' dag gsan/ga nyer bzhi par rgyal tsha sku gshegs khar gdams ngag rnams rdzogs par gnang / na de nas bal yul du byon/ paṇa chen bud+dha shrī dang / mi tra jo ki bsten da nas bod du gdan drangs/ gdams ngag mang du gsan zhing bod yul la pa dka' drin che ba byung / gtsang phyogs su gdul bya'i don bsam gyi mi /khyab gu pa mdzad nas ri bo rtse lngar bzhud/ dgung lo so gnyis la dbus su rje 'bri ca gung pa'i spyan sngar bka' brgyud pa'i lugs kyi dbang khrid gdams pa thams lo cad rdzogs pa gsan/ dgung lo gsum cu rtsa gsum la kha che paṇa chen dgung tha lo drug cu re lnga pa (/207)la gro mi'i lam la byon nas spyan drangs/ gzhi thams cad yod par smra ba'i mkhan brgyud las sdom rgyun rnam par dag pa dri

rgyal tsha rin chen mgon dang dbon kun ldan ras chung dang khre phu lo cwa rnams kyi rnam thar/ 77ma med pa da lta'i bar du ma chad par byung / khro phu dga' ldan gtsug lag /bang chen po btab/ byams chen khru brgyad bcu pa bzhengs/ nga/ṇa chen gyi mched zla sangs rgyas zla bas/ sing ga la gling du dgra bcom pa dngos su bzhugs pa gsan nas der byon nas mjal/ zla ba gsum bzhugs nas dgag dbye thob nas/ sangs rgyas kyi ring bsrel bzhugs pa'i mchod rten zhig dang me tog lnga za ma tog tu bcug nas rnying pa dang stor ba mi 'byung ba byin gyis brlabs nas/ paṇa chen shākya shrī dang / klu sgrub kyi sprul pa skyobs pa 'jig rten mgon po/ khro phu lo cwa ba byams pa dpal gyi byams chen rnams la 'buspru ched bskur ba/ me tog byams chen gyi dbu la phul/ bla ma'i lung bstan ltar khams ri bo cher sogs su byon nas gdul bya mang du 'dus/ de bzhin/ dbus gtsang / gnyal/ yor/ mnga' ris skor gsum la bstan pa rin po che'i gzhung man ngag dri ma med pa rnams dar zhing rgyas par mdzad/ dgung lo zhe brgyad sa mo yos bu'i lor /bro phu gnyen mkhar gyi brag seng ge rdzong du sgrub pa mdzad/ bla chen bsod nams dbang phyug /mkhan chen byang chub dpal/ gnyos lo/ rong pa rga lo sogs slob ma grangs las 'das pa la dbang khrid kyi gdams ngag gis smin par mjad/ paṇa grub gsum dang bka' brgyud kyi man ngag du ma bsdus nas man ngag brgya rtsa sogs mdzad/ 'gyur yang du ma mdzad nas lo (1225)de nyid la mya ngan las 'das so//

78 bka' brgyud chos 'byung nor bu'i phreng ba/gdan 'dzin byang sems chen po bsod nams seng ge/ de'i slob ma yang rtse ba rin chen seng ge/ de'i slob ma bu ston rin po che rin chen grub (1290—1364)sogs mkhas grub kyi skyes bu du ma byon/ phyis su kun mkhyen bu ston zhal lur gdan 'dren zhus nas/ ‘nal lu'i mkhan rabs bcu gcig pa gnang nas/ sku tshe hril por 'chad rtsod rtsom gsum gyi sgo nas rgyal bstan rin po che la srid zhu bla med mdzad/ phrin las shin tu rgyas pas zhal lu'i lugs zhes grags pa byung ngo // gzhan yang / rgyal tsha khu dbon gyi slob ma lce sgom dang / de'i slob ma ma cig re ma yin te mdor na/ slob ma/ yang slob dang bcas pa'i chos brgyud dar khyab byung ba 'di la khro phu bka' brgyud ces grags so//dar zh-ing rgyas par mdzad/ dgung la zh-i brgyad sa rma yis bu' lar /t+tha phu gnyen mkhar gyi brag seng ge rdzong du sgrub pa mdzad/ bla chen bsod nams dbang phyug /mkhan chen byang chub dpal/ gnyos lo/ rong pa rga lo sogs slob ma grangs las 'das pa la dbang khrid kyi gdams ngag gis smin par mjad/ paṇa grub gsum dang bka' brgyud kyi man ngag du ma bsdus nas man ngag brgya rtsa sogs mdzad/ 'gyur yang du ma mdzad nas lo (1225)de nyid la mya ngan las 'das so//

chos rje smar pa shes rab ye shes kyi rnam thar/ 7rdo)chos rje smar pa shes rab ye shes kyi rnam thar/smar tshang bka' brgyud ni/ 'gro mgon phag gru'i dngos sleb chos rje smar pa mdo khams 'bri klong gi cha lag tu gtogs pa/ smar shod dge rgyal bye ma'i klung zhes bya bar/ gdung go 'gye'i nang chan lha sa yab sgom pa klu'i gtsug ces bya ba'i sras gsum gyi tha chung du sku 'khrungs (1 134)/ chung ngu nas dad pa dang / shes rab/ snying rje che zhing / theg chen la mos nas gzhan phan 'ba' zhig mjad/ dpal rga lo las skyabs 'gro sems bskyed bzlas lung byin rlabs dang bcas pa gsan/ de nas bzung ste chos brgyad kyi blo dar cig kyang skye ba ma byung gsungs/ dgung lo bco lnga pa la sbas bla ma 'bom rgyas bya ba sngags dang mtshan nyid kyi chos la gsan sbyangs rgya chen po mkhas bcun ngo mtshar can zhig bzhugs pa'i drung du nye gnas byas/ bde mchog gi sgo nas dbang yongs su rdzogs pa dang / snyob dpon dril bu pa'i chos skor sogs gdams pa 'ga' zhig phung po lnga/ bye brag bshad pa sogs mngon pa'i chos phran mang po gsan/ dgung lo nyi shu la mkhan po dbu sig pa/ bla ma 'bam rgyal ba dang sbas bcun sher rgyal gyis slob dpon sogs dge 'dun grangs changs dbus su rab tu byung nas mtshan shes rab ye shes btags/ bslab pa rin po che mig 'bras bzhin bsrung ste bcas rang gyi kha na ma tho ba'i nyes lhung phra mos kyang ma gos/

8() bka' brgyud chos 'byung nor bu'i phreng ba /lo de nyid la dbus su 'byon grabs byas pas/ bla ma sba ston sher rgyal gyis khyod dbus su 'gro na nga'i chos grogs rdor rgyal bya ba'i ngo mtshar can zhig bzhugs pa de'i drung na song gsungs/ de nas dge bshes dar ma 'bum dang bsdebs nas dbus su byon/ gtsang nag gi drung nas dbu tshad sogs gsan sbyang mthar phyin mdzad/ bya 'dul gyis mkhan po/ cha pas slob dpon/gcang nag pas gsang ston zhus nas bsnyen par rdzogs/ mkhan slob las 'dul ba/ bla chos/ zhar chos lo lnga bsten nas mkhas pa'i grags pa thob/de nas lha sar rje sgom tshul dang mjal nas phyag chen la seges pa'i gdams pa 'ga' zhig gsan/ rgya gar skra ro las dbang dang gdams pa 'ga' zhigabaka' gdams bshes gnyen lung mo ba/ 'chad ka ba/ 'ching phu ba sogs las blo sbyong sogs mang du gsan/ rgyal ba lo las gtum mo sogs gdams pa/ rngo ga las rngeg pa'i dbang rgyud man ngag rnams lo gsum bsten/de nas 'od khri seng ge dpal gyis grogs byas nas phag grur phebs/ zhag bzhi na bla ma mjal/ tshogs chos thun bzhi gsan/ de nas bla mar gsol ba nan gyi btab kyang chos ye mi gsungs bar/ chos rje smar pa na ba'i dus myong ba sogs la ngo sprad kho na gnang / myong ba khyad par can mang po rgyud la skyes/ dpal lha mo dang dngos su zhal mjal / rmi lam du bdag med ma dang yang 'jal/ bla mas mtshan bcas mtshan med kyi khrid gdams pa phyag len

chos rje smar pa shes rab ye shes kyi rnam thar/ 81rnams dgyes bzhin rdzogs par gnang / ji ltar bstan pa bzhin mngon du gyur/ nyams myong gi 'char lugs/ rtogs pa'i skyes tshul/ gdams ngag gi gnad/ chos kyi mdo 'gag rnams la legs par dris shing zhu gtugs byas te/ sgro 'dogs chod par byas/ dge bshes zhang las lam 'bras gsan/'gro mgon phag gru'i zhabs drung du lo hril po lnga bzhugs/ de nas khams su 'byon pa na/ bla ma la dad mos kyi 'bral mi phod pa byung / bla mas gdams ngag dang nyams myong rnams zhib par gnang nas 'gro don chen po 'ong ba lung bstan/ mnga' gsol nas/ khams su 'byon pa'i lam du rje sgom chul dang mjal/ nyams myong gdams ngag rnams ji ltar gsan sgom gnang chul gsol bas/ dge bshes khams pas go bcad khyod la phan thogs par 'dug gsungs nas shin tu mnyes/dgung lo so gsum par yul du phebs/ lo mang sgom sgrub mdzad/ de nas 'dam steng du byon nas she (shā)dgon btab/ chos bzhin 'khor rnams skyong / chos phung brgyad khri bzhi stong shes kyang / ma bsgom par sangs mi rgya/gdams ngag ji ltar zab kyang nyams myong skye ba'i thabs yin pas sems thog kho nar khrid cing / sgom pa gtso bor khyer ba yin gsungs/ dad pa can sun mi phyung / shes rab can sgrogs su ma bcug /mos pa ji ltar yod pa bzhin de dang de'i lam la 'khrid pa la mkhas par mdzad nas tshogs pa yang

82 bka' brgyud chos 'byung nor bu'i phreng ba/ nyis stong tsam byung ba la rtogs ldan gyi skyes bu bsam gyi mi khyab mang du byung / bla ma rin po che gshegs par gsan nas gsol ba btab pas rmi lam du mjal nas/ rmi lam sprul pa'i zhus lan yang byung / yi dam gyi lha mang po'i zhal gzigs thob/ spyod lam rnam bzhi gang mdzad kyang mnyam bzhag chen po la ma g.yos bzhin mdzad spyod thams cad gzhan don kho nar gyur/ mthong thos dran reg gi 'brel thog rnams la ting nge 'dzin rtsolardzomed du skye ba sogs 'brel tshad don ldan mdzad/ dgung grangs drug cu re gsum bzhes pa'i dus su sku khams cung ma bde nas/ yo byad thams cad skrong dag gnang nas dpon tshul sogs drung du yod pa rnams la da res min gsungs/'dul bya snod dang ldan pa rnams la zab chos man ngag rnams gnang / 'aspo mgon rin po che'i gdung gi drung du 'bul chen yang bskur/ nub gcig rmi lam du slob dpon cha pa mjal nas gsang sngags khrom bsgrags su song tshul gsungs pas bshags pa yang mjad/de ltar rgyal ba'i bstan pa ji lta ba bzhin 'dzin pa'i yon tan tshad du skyel ba'i slob ma yang / yang dgon pa/ chos rje gsha' ma/ gze 'du ras pa/ ye shes rgyal mtshan sogs gzhan rgyud grol ba mang du byung / mthong thos dran reg rnams legs lam la bkod/ sku tshe mdzad pa mthar phyin cing /thugs dgongs ma lus rdzogs nas chu mo phag gi (1203)lo dgung grangs

ye la ye shes brtsegs pa'i rnam thar/ 8 3drug bcu rtsa dgu bzhes pa'i tshe/ chos kyi khri la byon nas slob 'bangs rnams la zhal gdams gnang / mchod pa rgya chen po gsham bla ma dang sangs rgyas kyi bstod pa mdzad nas/ ngo mtshar ba'i ltas du ma dang bcas te mya ngan las 'das so/ /de ltar chos rje smar pa'i gdan sa shwa yang dgon pa'i slob brgyud/rmog spyan snga rin po che/ shwa dbu rtse ba/ rnal rin chen gling sogs mang du byon pa la smar pa bka' brgyud du grags so//yel ye shes brtsegs pa'i rnam thar/yel pa bka' brgyud ni/ 'gro ba'i mgon po phag mo gru pa'i dngos slob yel ye shes brtsegs pa ni/ mdo khams kyi zla sing lung dang sar/ grong cham ti li yor gyi zur/ gdung rus ni ldong 'go bom ku to/ yab sgom pa a 'bar zhes pa/ sngags pa dam tshig can snying rje dang ldan pa gcig dang yum gong pa bza' bcun ma zhes pa la sras bzhi'i che ba shing pho stag lo (1134)la sku bltams/ chung ngu nas byis pa'i rgud pa dang bral/ dpal rga lo dang mjal nas lung bstan mdzad cing chos kyang gnang / klog la mkhas par mkhyen/bcu dgu chu pho sprel gyi lo la rba lci'i grong dbal gyi zur mdar byon/ mkhan po 'brom dang slob dpon mal jo ston pa las rab tu byung nas mtshan ye shes

8 / bka' brgyud chos 'byung nor bu'i phreng ba/brtsegs su gsol/ nyi shu pa la sngon gyi ma/ban slob drung du bsnyen par rdzogs nas 'dul gzhung cha lag dang bcas pa zhus nas legs par sbyangs/ mnga' ris slob ma chu chal bya ba las thun 'jog gsan nas sgom nyams bzang po byung / dgung lo nyer gsum me pho bya'i lor la dbus su phebs/ yang la las dgyes rdor/ do ha sogs gsan/ bla ma cha pa'i drung nas dbu ma sogs sde snod la gsan sbyong mdzad cing bka' gdams kyang bskyangs/ bla ma rngog las jog pa'i chos skor dbang brgyud man ngag rnams rdzogs par zhus/ zhong dar ma seng ge las mtshan nyid kyi chos skor mang po zhus/ nyin po ri pa shol so ba las rnam 'joms/ dngul chung ba las lha lnga dang bdag med gsan/par phu ba blo gros seng ge las bram ze chen po nas/ grud shul pa'i bar du brgyud pa'i do ha dang / a ma na se'i chos skor rnams zhus nas legs par brtasabarnga5/nyer dgu chu pho rta lo la/ phag mo grur byon nas bde gshegs rin po che mjal nas thun mong ma yin pa'i mos gus skyes/ rjes su bzung / dbang bskur/ bla ma'i rnal 'byor gnang nas sgom pas snang ba thams cad ban bun du song ba'i nyams byung / dbu ma'i lta ba thugs la 'khrungs/ skabs zhig bla mas spa ber thugs khar gtad nas khyod dang kho bo rnams ni srid pa tha ma ba'i byang chub sems dpa' yin/ khyod kyis sems can la phan thog par 'ong /

ye la ye shes brtsegs pa'i rnam thar/ 8ru5zhes rten 'brel lung ston mdzad/ de nas rin po che'i zhal nas kho bo'i dgun kar ya gcig khams su gtor ba rmis pas khyod /bams su bzhud la lci zla'i bar sgang brag dkar po seng ge gangs su bstsal ba lta bu'i zhol du phebs dang sems can mang po'i don 'byung gsungs/ de ltar lo ngo bdun rin po che'i zhabs la gtugs nas chos khrid rnams rdzogs par gsan/ bla mas kyang kho bo'i grwa sa phyed song ba yin thams cad kyi skyel ma gyis/ /bo bos kyang mig gi skyel ma byed gsungs nas/ stag lung thang pa sogs grogs mched rnams kyis phyag 'chal snang bar bskyal nas na bza' rnams brtsegs nas bzhugs su bcol te thams cad kyi tshos 'brel zhus/dgung lo so lnga pa sa pho byi ba'i lo la khams su byon/ cham tir byon nas lo gcig bzhugs/ de nas shag rgyal dang dpon slob gsum yel phug gzigs su byon pa'i rmi lam du me tog ser chen bkra cha le ba gzigs nas/dgung lo so brgyad lcags mo yos kyi lo la dgon pa btab/ de'i sa brtags ni mdun du dril zhal/ rgyab tu phag zhal/ g.yon du dung zhal brag la yod par grags/ thugs dam gyi rten dngul sku rnam gnyis sogs nang bzhugs mdzad pas 'gro don lhun grub tu byung nas sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa dar bar mdzad/ sgom phug dpag tu med pa byung / sgyin bdag gi 'bul tshogs jag pas bcom pa la brten/ snying rje chad med skyes nas bla ma la dad gus gdung

8() bkaspru brgyud chos 'byung nor bu'i phreng ba/ shugs thun mong ma yin pa skyes te/ yon tan khyad par can rgyud la 'khrungs/bla ma gnas nang bas thugs rje chen por mjal bas zhal gyi bzhes/ phar yang rnam snang du gzigs nas phan tshun phyag mdzad/ gzhan yang slob ma rnams kyi yi dam gyi lhar mthong ba/ mngon shes mnga' ba rdzu 'phrul bstan pa sogs ni brjod par mi lang / lo bco brgyad bar du yel phug gi tshogs pa bskyangs/de nas yon bdag 'brug 'bum rag shi kha 'dzong gis gdan drangs nas mdo mang dang gnas gzhi sogs brgya 'bul mang du byas/ dgon pa phul ba bzhes nas dgung lo nga lnga sa pho smre'u lo la rta rna dgon/ sa'i rtags rgyal srid sna bdun dang ldan par phyag btab/ dge 'dun dang sgrub pa po mang du tshogs/ chos rje smar pas gdan drangs pas sho dgon du byon nas/ grogs mched rnams chos dang mthun pa'i gsung gleng / 'jig rten dang mthun pa'i skyes chen po bsnyen bkur brje res gnang /byang 'od dang seng 'bum gnyis kyi yon bdag byas nas/ dgung lo nga dgu chu pho byi ba'i lo la/ lho stod 'jang gi dgon pa btab/ der yang dge 'dun mang du 'dus/ lci zla ru gsum du sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa rin po che dar zhing rgyas par mdzad/ de ltar chos rje yel ye shes brtsegs pa gdan sa gsum du le nyer bzhi bzhugs pa'i ring / 'chad nyan skom sgrub chos kyi

1(/ni bka' brgyud chos lngang nor bu'i preng ba/de nas rgya gar gyi gnas chen dang dur khrod la sogs par ro stoms la 'byon bzhed pa la/ chos rjes bla ma sku khams bzang ring la 'dir sdod gsungs nas bzhugs/ de'i skabs pha spun gyis yum dang sring mo mnar ba'i gtam dang mched grogs kyis chags sdang byed pa/ lus la shig nad tshabs che ba/ thugs rlung la sogs 'gal rkyen drag po byung yang / bla ma'i mos gus dang ma bral bar thams cad dge sbyor gyi grogs su gyur/ rje'i zhabs drung nas gdams ngag rnams rdzogs par gsan/ dbus su chos khri'i zur du khang chung brtsigs nas tshogs chos rnams kyang mtshams khongs nas gsan/ lo nyi shu rtsa lnga pa la chos rje rgya ras gshegs/de nas /ba rag gi rtse mo jo mo gro sar byon/ jo dan kun rgyal phyag phyir 'byor/ kho bsod snyo/mas la song ba'i shul kha ba chen po babs/ de la kho ma thar/ bla ma la gsol zas med snyam khos snying rus bskyed 'ongs nas phug pa'i phyi/ chos rjes nang nas brkos par 'tsho ba cung zad 'phrod tsam las /chu me shing yang blang du med pa lo gsum bzhugs/ der bsnun gzhi dam po zhig byung ba sdig sgrib dag pa'i rtags bzang byung / byang gnam mtsho phyug mo do la sgom pa bzhed nas dar ma chags pa/ nya pa gzhon nus ko gru btang nas mtsho dkyisnyewa du snyebs pa na rlung dmar zhabrugs/ 'chi ba min pa'i thabs med byung skabs mos gus gdung bas gsol ba btab pas/ chos rje mngon sum

lo ras grags pa dbang phyug gi rnam thar/ /()sdo)ko gru rdzings kyi /bo na phebs/ rlung dmar zhi/ lo gcig sgrub pa mdzad/ phyi do'i sgom chen rnams kyis nan gyi spyan drangs do phyir byon/ slar (zhu mo do la byon nas sgrub pa mdzad/ dar ma chags pas yun ring lus/ 'tsho ba zad kyang dge sbyor bzang ba byung / nyin gcig nye gnas dge 'dun dar snyel dar yod ltos gsungs/ gzhan mi snang snam bu brkyang pa 'dra zhig mthong / de la chos rjes sna drangs byon/ pha gi'i ru gseb tu phebs pa'i tshe/ gang nas 'ong zer bas nged zhwa mo do nas 'ongs byas pas mtsho la dar rul nas sus bgrod rdzun yin zer/ dgong mo ri la phyugs 'tshor 'gro ba rnams log nas/ de ring ru gseb tu btsun pa gnyis zhwa mo do nas chu la ma bying bar 'byon pa mthong zer bas kun dad/ gzhan yang jo mo gangs rnams su rgyun ring bar bzhugs/ dka' ba dpag tu med pa spyad cing nang sems kyi nad dang phyi 'byung po'i bar chad/ dka' thub kyi gegs la sogs pa blo las 'das pa mang po byung ba rnams thugs dam gyi grogs su song nas nang ye shes kyi stobs rgyas/ mngon par shes pa chen po dang yang ldan/ bla ma dang yi dam lhas lung bstan bzhin dge 'dun mang du 'dus pa rnams la sgom btab/ chu mig jidakar mo/ shing skam/ lcags spyil/ u ri la sogs pa'i dgon pa btab nas gzhan don bskyangs/ lo bdun ba(nugs nas gdams ngag gi gco bo thub pa lnga mdzad cing tshogs pa'ang stong lhag 'dus 'gro don rgya cher mdzad/
