rgya la ba rgod tshang pa'i rnam thar/ /1 )bar zhus pas gnang nas dbu ru byang phyogs kyi bla ma bzang chad ma chos 'bresnyel zhus/ rwa sgreng / stag yung / tshal pa sogs/ dang mjal yang chos rje rgya ras la mos gus cher song / dgung lo nyer gsum par slar 'brug tu phebs/ chos rje gshegs khar gdan sa dbon ras dar ma seng ge la mnga' gse(pa bas sangs rgyas dbon las bsnye/na par rdzogs te/ bla ma chos rje ras pa yin/ /drin can sangs rgyas dpen ras yin/ /gsungs/chos 'a/bor chen po bcugs nas slob dpon nyis brgya dang bdun cu/dge 'dun bzhi stong brgyad brgya 'tshogs/ 'gro don gya che mjad/ de nas sgo brag mkhar chu/ gangs ti si/ kha che'i yul/ dza lan dha ra la sogs par byon zhing bzhugs nas sgrub pa /bo na mjad/ ma/bar chu nas gzung ste gnas de rnams su grub rtags 'ga' re yang bstan/ ja lan dha ra na tshogs 'khor chen po zhig na tshogs dpon rnal 'byor rma/sa rnal 'byor pa de thong gsung /tshogs 'khor mdzad de rnal 'byor ma rjes su bzung nas phyis zhabs drung na yed pa'i 'gro ba bzang mo yin/ chom rkun gyis gser yod du re nas bsgugs pas bla ma spyi bor basmroms pas nyerba/ par ma gyur/ de nas ra lung du byon nas dbon ras dar ma seng ge dang mjal/ /lha khab tu lo gsum bla ma sgrub pa mdzad pas chos rje rgya ras sa bcu'i byang chub sems dpa' yi na snya/ma pa byung / sems sangs rgyas su ngo sprod pa'i bla ma la sa bcu byang sems mthong

sde /tsho/ bka' brgyud ches hrūng nor bu'i phreng ba/ba khyod /spo na byas nas rang la smad/ phyin chad sangs rgyas kyi 'du shes 'bral ma myong / der lo gsum bshugs ring spyisnyespru bo chus gang nas sku smad chu nang las mi g.yo ba/ gso ba chu 'thung kho na mdzad/ nyin gcig mtsho 'gram sha ba'i ro gcig 'dug pa rkyang gcig la bkal nas 'tsho ba bskyal/ dus shig nam mkha' la skrul gyi char 'bab pa'i snang ba byung zhing des rkyen byas nas bskun mje byung ba'ang myur du dwangs/ tsa ri la lo gsum bzhugs/ g.yu mtsho skor ba la byon pas mkha' 'gro ma seng ge gdong can gyis gser skyogs gang gnang byung ba'ang mtsho mchod mjad/ tsa ri bzhugs dus g.yog 'ba' zhig mjad pas rdza khrod shar nub kyi bong bu ser po zer ba'ang byung / ma chen pa rnams kyi rtsam pa skyel 'dren gyi sgal pa rnag tu song song gi bar du mjad thugs ni bred par byung gsung / der nub cig mnal lam du nang lto thams cad mthong nas /bog pa stong par song ba rmis/ da 'di phyir ldog gam mi ldog snyam pa la mi dkar po cig na re/ da lan rang 'di mi ldog zer/ der thugs dam shin tu 'phel bar gyur nas/ slar chos rjes sangs rgyas dbon dang mjal/ da nga'i khrid gnyer gyis gsung / kho bo la stod du 'gro 'dod zhus pas ma gnang / grub thob yin min lta byas nas lkog tu maṇ+ḍal mang po phul/gzod zhu ba phul bas/ 'o na song / bstan pa med pa'i sa phyogs su bla ma'i bstan pa dar bar byas na de rang zhabs tog che gsungs/ la stod du byon

rgyal ba rgod tshang rnga/'i na ma thar/ sdi15nas bya rog tshang du pa sgrub pa zhig po dang mjal bas kun tu bzang po bya ba 'di rang yin snyam pa'i mos pa byung / gdams ngag kyang zhib tshags dang bcas te gnang / de nas khyung dkar/ yang dkar rnams su sgrub pa mdzad nas thugs dam 'phel/ de nas rgod tshang du byon nas/ mi nga dang / bya /khyod dang / brag 'di gsum ming gcig tu ma song bar bskrub pa'i dam bca' mdzad nas bsgrubs pas rgod chang pa zhes mtshan thogs/ brag phug dog por yod pa la/ snang ba 'di kun zang nge thal le rang 'dug pa gsungs gin brag phug yangs por song / rdo rje rnapa 'byor mas po ti cig byin pa mid pas skros thams cad ma/byen/ bod du 'gyur ba'i chos la mi shes pa med gsungs/ sngar gzhan don mi mdzad par snya/ma pa'i blo yod pa der log /mi dang mi min rnams la gdams pa dang rjes su gdams pa gnang 'gro don rgya cher mdzad/ chos rje 'dis gnas chen rnams su bde sdug sna tshogs byung ba rkyen dang bsres pa dang / shig nad lan mang po byung ba'ang byang chub kyi sems kyis shig gcig tsam yang ma dor bar rkyen phyag rgya chen po dang bsres pas/ dge sbyor gyi gtso po phyag rgya chen po dang ma bral ba mos gus kho na mdzad/ thun mong gi dam bca' bcu gsum/ thun min gyi dam bca' bdun khyad 'phags kyi dam bca' lnga sogs mdzad de sgrub pa'i rgyal mtshan mthar phyin/sku tshe'i smad la steng gro/ spud dra byang gling / bde chen steng / bar 'brog

sdi 1() bka' brgyud chos 'byung nor bu'i phreng ba/rdo rje gling la sogs pa'i gdan sa mang du btab/ dgon pa re re nas kyang dge 'dun sgrub pa po stong tsho mang po thon pa byung / de ltar chos rje 'di dgung lo bcu dgu la rab tu byung nas lo ngo gsum chos rje gtsang pa'i drung du bzhugs/ ma/bar chur lo gsum dang / ti si dang ja lan dha rar lo bzhi/ lha khab tu lo gsum/ rtsa rir lo gsum/ khyung dkar dang yang kar gnyis su lo gsum/ rgod tshang du lo bdun/ stong sror lo bcu gsum/ bde chen stengs dang dga' ldan gnyis su lo hril po dgu/ seng ge gling dang hong thang gnyis su lo gcig/ rdo rje gling du le gnyis bzhugs te mthar dgung grangs bdun cu sa pho rta la (1258)dgongs pa yongs su mya ngan las 'das/rjes su bka' brgyud kyi bstan pa 'dzin pa'i skye ba gcig de'i rjes su byang chub sems dang/'a ma chags pad+ma'i spyan bya ba steng phyogs su 'khrungs nas rtsol med kyi gzhan don mdzad/ de rjes 'jig rten gyi khams rdul dang bral ba zhes bya bar de bzhin gshegs nga/ rdul sel zhes bya bar sangs rgya'o zhes bka' bstsal/ gshegs rjes su /skral bsngu da dang rten bzhengs pa sogs ma byed par ri /brod rnams su tshe blos btang gi skrub pa gyis/ su chos bzhin byed pa rnams nga'i gdan sa 'jin pa yin gsungs so//de la slob ma rtogs pa rang dang mnyam pa yang dgon pa/ brtul zhugs rang dang mtshonyam pa u rgyan pa/ zhe bcad rang dang ma‘nyam pa spyil dkar ba/

rgyasnyel ba yang dgon pa'i rnam thar/ sde 17mos gus rang dang mnyam pa ne rings pa/ phu re ba/ ma bdun pa/ zhi byed mgon po sogs grangs las 'das pa phyon to//rgyal ba yang dgon pa'i rnam thar/rgyal ba yang dgon pa ni la stod lho p+ta gdong du/ sngags brgyud yab jo bsam dang yum chos mthong gi sras su 'khrungs/(12/3—1258)yum gyi lhums su zhugs pa'i che na yum la rmi ltas khyad par can mang po dang / ting nge 'dzin rang 'khrungs su skye ba byung / bltams nas ring po ma lon par/skyabs su 'chi'o bya ba'i gsung 'byon/ klog dang yi ge'ang bslab ma dgos pa mkhyen nas yum gyis thog drangs nye 'kher na yod pa rnams dam pa'i chos 'ba' zhig la bskusnyel ba'i gsungs 'byon/ skye ma thag nas 'gro ba'i bdag por gyur/ chung ngu nas yab gshegs/ lo lnga nas gzhan la phan pa'i mgur mang po gsungs/ thams cad du sprul pa'i sku byon par grags/ sangs rgyas mi bskyod rdo rje zhes bya ba zhig wum bu la byon pas sus kyang ngo ma shes pa la/bu chung des mkhyen nas pang du byon te dgyes par mjad pas thugs dam bogs che/ phyis sangs rgyas mi bskyod rdo rje byon nas rin po che dang mja‘pa/jo sras dbyangs shig long gsung ba la/ bla ma rje la phyag 'tshal lo/ /sgyu ma'i

118 bka' brgyud chos 'gyung nor bu'i phreng ba/mi chung 'bar ba nga / /snga ma'i las 'phro sad pa yin/ /bla ma'i byin rlabs zhugs pa yin/ /lta ba gza' gtad bral ba yin/ /sgom pa dmigs gtad bral ba yin/ /spyod pa spang blang bral ba yin/ /'bras bu re dogs bral ba yin/ /zhes bya ba snyespru sogs gsungs pa/ thugs mnye sa nas phyag thal mo sbyar te rdzogs chen la ska rags bcings pa cig 'dug gsungs nas spyan chab bsil nas mnga' bdag myang gi gter kha'i skor dang /zhi byed kyi chos sker sogs gnang / lo drug bzhes pa'i tshe phul dmar pa'i drung nas sgyu 'phrul gyi dbang dang rdzogs pa chen po'i rgyud gdams ngag dang bcas pa dang / bka' gdams/ zhi byed/ gcod yul/ lam 'bras snying po skor zhal gdams rgyab chos dang bcas pa dpag tu med pa gsan/ phul dmar ba'i drung du lo gsum bzhugs/ dgung lo dgu pa la lha gdong gi gdan sa mdzad/chung dus nas mngon shes mnga'/ ko brag pa/ sa skya paṇa chen/ rje spyan snga/sangs rgyas ras chen sogs dang / snyelhog par rgyal ba rgod tshang pa'i zhabs la gtugs nas thun mong dang thun min gyi chos ma lus par lon par mdzad/spo dgu nas tshogs pa bskyangs nas gnan la /khrid btab/ dgung ro nyi shu rtsa gnyis pa la mkhan po lha btsun sog kha ba/ las slo/ba ko brag pa/ gsang ston dred chung / las gral ba brgyad cu'i drung du bsnye/na par rdzogs/ mtshan rgyal mtshan dpal du gsol/

spyan snga ba rin chen ldan gye rnam thar/ 11sbyo)phyis shrī ri gnam sdings kyi dgon pa btab/ der lo gcig gi bar du rdo rje dkyil dkrung gcig gi sa bzhugs/ bu le la sogs gnas rnams su yang khrid skyong zhing dben pa bsten/ snya/na pa che bas phyogs mtha' dag nas 'dus pa'i slob ma khri phrag brgal/ slob ma rnams kyi bskul bas ri chos skor gsum dang ma drug la sogs pa'i brtsams chos kyang mang du mdzad/mthar zhe drug bzhes pa sa pho rta'i ro (1258 )la 'bar 'brog tu byon/ der lcags dur du sku khams (nan pa'i tshul bstan/ de na shri rir spyan drangs te der ches bcu dgu la dgongs pa gshegs/de'i slob ma mang du byung ba las/ gtso bo spyan snga rin chen ldan zhes bya ba sku shin tu phra ba'i dus nas rgyal ba yang dgon pa'i zhabs la gtugs te 'bralarumed du bzhugs nas bka' yi bsdu ba po mdzad pa dang / sku ras chos skyong dpal /zhes bya ba rtsa rlung smu rang dbang thob pa de gnyis ni gtso bo'o//spyan snga me rin chen ldan gyi rnam thar/spyan snga ba rin chen ldan ni/ ding rir chu pho khyi'i lo (12()2)la zhabrungs/rgyal ba yang dgon pa 'a/sa lo bcu gcig gi snga bar 'khrungs/ lha gdong na dzil pa'i sku dgung lo lnga'i skabs bzhugs nga/'i sngags brjod thos pas shin

/2() bka' brgyud chos 'byung ner bu'i phreng ba/tu dad nas mjal/ mos gus thun mong ma yin pa 'khrungs/ ting nge 'dzin yang rtsol med du skyes/ chos 'bre'/ zhus pas bla ma'i rnal 'byor dang phyag rgya chen po ye ge bzhi pa gsan/ pha jo ston pa las 'bri klog la sogs bslab zhing gsan pa mang du mdzad/ de nas snyelha gdong pa chos rje ko brag pa'i drung du dgung lo bcu gcig lon pa'i sprul sku gcig byon pa dang mjal nas mos gus tshad med skyes/ de nas yang dgon pa'i phyags phyi 'brangs nas zhi ba gshegs kyi bar lo sum cu rtsa snyelnga'i ring zhabs drung du zhag gcig kyang ma bral bar spyan sngar bzhugs pas spyan snga bar grags/ chos rje yang dgon pa la bzhugs pa'i gsar rnying gi dbang gdams pa lung la sogs pa gang bzhugs thams cad gsan/ ko brag pa'i drung nas kyang chos mang du zhus/rgod tshang pa la'ang 'brug skor thams cad gsan/ sa paṇa las sa skya'i chos skor rnams (nus/ rje smyan snga las 'bri /bung pa'i chos skor rnams gsan/gzhan yang bla ma bzang dgu la gtugs nas gdams ngag zab dgu gsan/sgrub pa'i rgyal mtshan btsugs/ gnas lugs kyi rtogs pa shar/ phyis ding rir bzhugs nas tshogs pa mtha' yas pa bskyangs pas slob ma'i mchog gyur/ zur phug pa dang / grub thob nyi ma margan la sogs pa'i rtogs ldan gyi slob ma mang du byon/

zur phug pa rin chen dpapa gyi rnam thar/ /2/zur phug pa rin chen dpal gyi rnam thar/zur phug pa rin chen dpal ni/ shen gyi dpe'u chung du sku zhabrungs/ mdo sngags kyi sbyangs pa mang du mdzad/ grub chen o rgyan pa dang spyan snga rin ldan las rtogs pa rnyed/ gdams ngag rdzogs te shri zur phug tu 'phrin las bskyangs/ slob ma ri ba dge 'dun rgyal mtshan dang de'i slob ma gtsang pa blo bzang pa bya ba'i 'phrin las can byung / khyad par 'ba' ra ba ni bstan pa'i bdag po rang gi brgyud pa logs su 'dzin nus pa byung ngo / ༄ / / ca7 ོ/ / 'i/ / d+ngha rdzo / /bzhugs thams cad gsan/ ka brag pa' drung nas kyang ches mang du zhus/rgod tshang pa la'ang 'brug skor thams cad gsan/ sa paṇa las sa skya'i chos skor rnams snyenus/ rje smyan snga las 'bri /stung pa'i chos skor rnams gsan/gzhan yang bla ma bzang dgu la gtugs nas gdams ngag zab dgu gsan/sgrub pa'i rgyal mtshan btsugs/ gnas lugs kyi rtogs pa shar/ phyis ding rir bzhugs nas tshogs pa mtha' yas pa bskyangs pas slob ma'i mchog gyur/ zur phug pa dang / grub thob nyi ma margan la sogs pa'i rtogs ldan gye slob ma mang du byon/

122 bkasnyespru brgyud chos nagrang nor bu'i phreng ba/ chos rje 'ba' ra ba rgyal mtshan dpal bzang 8) rna64 thasmon/'ba' ra ba ni shangs kyi chab lung par dpon 'bum zhes pa'i sras su lcag pho khyi la 'khrungs(/310—/39/)gzhon nu nas chos rje bla ma dam pa bsod nams rgyal mtshan gyi gsol bya ba mdzad/ gsan bsam mthil phyin nges 'byung skyo shas drag po 'khrungs nas chos la bros/ sgro mon can pa/ shug gseb ri pa snyel sogs bla ma mang du bsten nas gdams khrid zhus pas ji lha ba yi gnas lugs 'khrungs/ lhag par zur phug pa las dkar brgyud kyi gdams ngag rnams rdzogs par gsan te bsgoms pas rtogs pa mchog tu gyur/ 'ba' ra brag tu don grub ldings btab/de las slob brgyud kyis bod kun bkang / yang slob mon rtse ba zhes pa las mched nas 'brog/ dbus/ kong po sogs su chos brgyud dar/dbus smyon kun dga' bzang po las kyang slob brgyud mang du mched/ 'phrin las shin tu che zhing brgyud 'dzin la 'ba' ra dkar brgyud zhes grags/mthar dgung grangs brgyad cu rgya gnyis la spa gror byon te/ lcags mo lug (/391)gi lo la gshegs so//gdan sa ni dbon brgyud kyis bzung zhing / lum pa ba kun dga' don

chos rje 'ba' ra ba rgyal mtshan dpal bzang ge rnam thar/ /2 t+pāgrub/ gtsang pa blo gros bzang po (1360—1423)de'i slob ma 'brog /bang dmar pa kun dga' dpal ldan sogs de dag las grub pa'i skyes bu tshad med pa byung ba 'di ni stod 'brug gnam gyi skar ma zhes bya zhing/ phyis chos rje 'ba' ra ba'i phrin las phyogs mthar khyab pa'i brgyud 'dzin la 'ba' ra dkar brgyud zhes kyang grags pa 'di byung ngo // / — / ོ ༄ / 7 / ri 4ོbyu / tre / / dzo / d+nghagadams ngag rnams rdzags par gsan ta bsgams pas rtegs pa mcheg tu gyur/ 'ba' ra brag tu don grub ldings btab/de las slob brgyud kyis bod kun bkang / yang slob mon rtse ba zhes pa las mched nas 'brog/ dbus/ kong po sogs su chos brgyud dar/dbus smyon kun dga' bzang po las kyang slob brgyud mang du mched/ 'phrin las shin tu che zhing brgyud 'dzin la 'ba' ra dkar brgyud zhes grags/mthar dgung grangs brgyad cu rgya gnyis la spa gror byon te/ lcags mo lug ( 1391)gi 'e/ la gshegs rbedu//gdan sa ni dbon brgyud kyis bzung zhing / lum pa ba kun dga' don

12tsho 1 bka' brgyud chos 'gyur rnar bu'i phreng ba/grub thob༄kyi rgyan pa'i rnam thar/ rgyal ba rgod tshang pa'i slob ma mtha' yas kyang brtul zhugs rang dang mnyam pa grub thob u rgyan pa ni/ zur tshe'i go lung du rus rgyus/ mdo smad dbyar mo thang du rgyus byang chub gzhon nu bya ba glob dpon pad+ma'i dngos slob/chos rgyal /khri srong lde btsan gyi mchod gnas su gyur/ snying ma'i grub thob 'ba' zhig gi brgyud par/ yab jo phan dang yum dug ge me gnyis kyi sras su lcags pho stag gi (/230)lor 'khrungs/ mtshan seng ge dpal du gsol/lo bdun nas rgod chang pa bhu ṭar byon pa la dge bsnyen blangs/ de nas bcu drug gi bar du ma phur bde dgyes/ phyag rdor/ yo ga rgyud phyag len dang bcas pa la ma/bas par mdzad/ de nas bo dong er byon bo dong rin rtse sogs bla ma rnams las mngon pa gong 'og tshad ma rnam nges/ shes rab 'grel chung /snyerigrel chung / dbu tshad byams chos 'dul ba'i skor/ khyad par las brgya rtsa gcig pa gzigs pa tsam gyis thugs su chud/ sprul pa'i sku la slob gnyer bya ma dgos par 'dug gsungs/ dgung lo nyi shu pa la bo dong rin rtse ma/ban po/ zhang bsam gling pas slob dpon/ slob dpon bsod 'od pas gsang sten mdzad nas tshig rdzogs bsgrubs/ mtshan rin chenadapal gsol/ de nas lo bcu gnyis su stan gcig pa'i brtul zhugs gzung / sha'ang ma gsol/

grub thoba.u rgyan pa'i rnam thar/ /25bo dong rin rtse las dus 'khor 'brog lugs/ go lung pa las chag lugs gsan/ rtsis la mkhas pa byas nas dus 'khor ba sangs rgyas rdo rje las ca mi lugs gsan dgos gsungs nas rong du brdzangs/ zla ba bcu gcig tu lung phran dang bcas pa gsan/ chos bcag nas ser chags la byon pas thugs cung zad skyo/ dam pa la gsol ba btab pas/ mnal lam du mja'/ zhing lung yang bstan/de rnams char nas chos rje rgod tshang pa bde chen steng dgon par bzhugs par mjal du phebs pa tsam gyis ro gcig gi rtogs pa 'khrungs/ bka' brgyud kyi gdams pa mtha' dag gsan/ skabs shig dus 'khor gyi dka' phreng ma bde ba rnams dogs gcod la sham+bha la 'gro bsam yod pa bla ma la shus pas/ ma bde ba ji 'dra yod gsungs pa la/ lan 'di dang 'di min gyi lan ji lta ba bzhin du gnang bas/ u rgyan pa ha las te 'di lta bu'i dus 'a/spor mkhas par ma/byen pa su las gsan zhus pas/ shri rir bsdad dus bud med dmar mo zhig gi po ti byin/ de mid pa'i snang ba byung nas chos gang la'ang mi shes pa ma byung ba yin gsungs/ 'o na bdag la dus 'khor gyi dbang gnang bar zhu zhus pas gsol ba tho ba la rmi lam gzung bar gsungs pas/ tho rangs rmi lam du chos rje rgod tshang pa dus 'khor ba sangs rgyas rdo rje yin no snyam pa zhig gis dkyil 'khor gyi las rim rgyas pa byas

/2() bkari brgyud chos 'byung nor bu'i phreng ba/te dbang bskur rdzogs par sbyin pa rmis/ sang de chos rje'i spyan sngar byon pas/ sgrub dpon jo bcun thugs chim mam gsungs/ shin tu tshim lags/de 'dra'i phyag len ma/bas pa gang snyepa gsan zhus pas mkha' 'gro mas bslab pa yin gsungs/ de phyin chos rje sangs rgyas dngos su gzigs/sham+bha la na las 'brel mi 'dug dngos kyi las 'brel u rgyan du 'dug der song gsungs/ thog mar byang mi med kyi thang la zla ba dgu skrub pas thugs dam shin tu 'phel bas sngar gyi chos brjed pa thams cad dran sos/ ti ser byon te phyi nang gzhan gsum dbyer med kyi don thugs la 'khrungs/ ngan rtog gi rgyun bcad/ mang yul dang pu hrang rgyud grogs mched dang 'grogs nas ku lu ta/ ma ru'i gnas/ ri bo chen po ga dha la rgyud/ dza lan+tarar byon la gu ra/ dz+wa smu mu /be/ mi tra swā ra la sogs pa gzigs/grogs gsum snod min mkhyen nas phyir slog dpal ye khrid de u rgyan du byon lam du cho 'phrul bsam gyi mi khyab pa byung / mu stegs pa dang sog po'i nye ba 'tshe ba rnams zil gyis mnan te/ chu bo tsan dha bha ga brgal/ grong khyer pra hā ra/ ra tsa hur rgyud chu bo sid+dhā brgal te rim gyis i lo par pa ta zhes bya ba'i ri la/ chos kyi phung po dnge ye shes kyi mkha' 'gro ma grub thob rnal 'byor mang du bzhugs zhing tshogs 'khor mdzad pa gzigs/ ri'i khar sngon rgyal po in+da bradhi gyur pa gsal bar dran/ de nas u rgyan sprul pa'i zhing

grub thob u rgyan pa'i na ma thar/ /27dhu ma tha lar rdo rje rnal 'byor ma smad 'tshong ma'i bu mo'i gzugs su byas pa zhig gis thug pa phor gang byin pa 'thungs pas skad cig la lus mi gcig pa bcu bdun blangs pa'i snang ba sogs regs drug gi gnas sbyong / shes pa za zir rig pa nges bzung med pa 'khrul snang log gnas thams cad bcom ldan 'das rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i dkyil 'a/bor gyi 'khor spo mngon sum gzigs/ bcom ldan 'das mas rdo rje gsum gyi bsnyen sgrub bstsal nas rgyud sde rab 'byams kyi dgongs pa thams cad rtegs/ nang rdo rje'i rus kyi gnas lugs ji lta ba mngon sum mthong / dhu ma tha la'i nub na ka ma ta ko'i gangs la/ dpal bde mchog mngon sum bzhugs pa gzigs/ rgyasnyel po in+d+ra brnyis bzhengs pa'i gcug lag khang du gnas gsum gyi mkha' 'gro sprin ltar 'du zhing chos gsung ba byung / /ba che'i yul du byon/ shrī na ga ra/wan+ti pur/ po ji bha rar paṇ+ḍi ta bhū mi shrī sogs las chos zhus/ /ba che'i rgyal pos gsod mi sum cu cam zhig btang ba lam du 'phrad kyang grogs mched gnyis ka ci yang ma nyes pa thar/ slar ja lan+tar nas yul nyi shu rtsa bzhi'i dgu gzigs/ bde sdug gi rkyen la ro snyo/mas mdzad/ zab lam snya/na sgrub kyi man ngag lon/ bla ma rgod tshang pas lo bcu gnyis na mnyam rjes med pa'i rtogs pa 'char ba lung bstan pa 'di la dgongs 'dug gsungs/ mnga' ris su bla chen de /byim gyis span drangs shing gces phrug brga rab tu byung zhing dpe 4 dbyi rmo
